translations.idiomatic: Seventy disciples and twenty-two scholars were painted on the walls.

sentences.zh: 以顏子亞聖，上親為之贊，以書于石。

translations.literal: Because Yanzi is Second Sage, the emperor personally composed his eulogy and had it written on stone.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor inscribed Yan Hui's eulogy in stone as Second Sage.

sentences.zh: 閔損已下，令當朝文士分為之贊。

translations.literal: From Min Sun downward, he ordered the current court literati to divide and compose eulogies.
translations.idiomatic: Court writers composed eulogies for the other disciples.

sentences.zh: 二十七年八月，又下制曰：

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-seventh year an edict was again issued:
translations.idiomatic: Year 27, eighth month: a new edict declared:

sentences.zh: 弘我王化，在乎儒術。

translations.literal: To expand our royal transformation lies in Ru learning.
translations.idiomatic: Royal transformation depended on Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 孰能發揮此道，啟迪含靈，則生人已來，未有如夫子者也。

translations.literal: Who can unfold this Way and enlighten the teeming folk—since living men have been, there has been none like the Master.
translations.idiomatic: No teacher had equaled the Master in enlightening mankind.

sentences.zh: 所謂自天攸縱，將聖多能，德配乾坤，身揭日月。

translations.literal: What is called self-so from Heaven, about to be sage and many in ability, virtue matching Heaven and Earth, body raising sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-born, multitalented, his virtue matched cosmos and sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 故能立天下之大本，成天下之大經，美政教，移風俗，君君臣臣，父父子子，人到於今受其賜。

translations.literal: Therefore he could establish the great root of all under Heaven and complete the great warp of all under Heaven, beautify government and teaching, shift customs, lord and minister each as lord and minister, father and son each as father and son—people to this day receive his gift.
translations.idiomatic: He set the foundations of order, civilized government, and right relations—mankind still lives by his gift.

sentences.zh: 不其猗歟！

translations.literal: Is it not abundant!
translations.idiomatic: How abundant his legacy!

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Ah!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 楚王莫封，魯公不用，俾夫大聖，才列陪臣，棲遲旅人，固可知矣。

translations.literal: The King of Chu did not enfeoff him; the Duke of Lu did not employ him—making the great sage rank only as a companion minister, lingering as a traveler—it can be known.
translations.idiomatic: Unenfeoffed by Chu and unused by Lu, the sage had been only a companion minister and wanderer.

sentences.zh: 年祀浸遠，光靈益彰，雖代有褒稱，而未為崇峻，不副於實，人其謂何？

translations.literal: Years and sacrifices gradually distant, his luminous spirit ever more manifest—though each age had praise, it was not yet lofty veneration, not matching the reality—what will people say?
translations.idiomatic: His fame had grown, yet honors still fell short of his stature.

sentences.zh: 朕以薄德，祗膺寶命，思闡文明，廣被華夏。

translations.literal: We with slight virtue reverently received the precious mandate, thinking to unfold civilization and broadly cover Huaxia.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor claimed modest merit yet sought to spread civilization across China.

sentences.zh: 時則異於今古，情每重於師資。

translations.literal: The times then differed from past and present; feeling each time weighed on teachers and models.
translations.idiomatic: Times had changed, but respect for teachers deepened.

sentences.zh: 既行其教，合旌厥德。

translations.literal: Having already practiced his teaching, we should display his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: His teaching was practiced; his virtue must be displayed.

sentences.zh: 爰申盛禮，載表徽猷。

translations.literal: Thereupon we extend the great rites and bear forth the emblematic plan.
translations.idiomatic: Grand rites would proclaim his merit.

sentences.zh: 夫子既稱先聖，可追諡為文宣王。

translations.literal: The Master already being called Former Sage may be posthumously enfeoffed as King Wén Xuān.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius was posthumously enfeoffed as King Wén Xuān.

sentences.zh: 宜令三公持節冊命，應緣冊及祭，所司速擇日，並撰儀注進。

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the Three Excellencies to hold credentials and confer the patent; for all connected with the patent and sacrifice the relevant offices should quickly choose the day and also draft ritual notes and submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Excellencies were to confer the patent; offices were to fix dates and ritual protocols.

sentences.zh: 其文宣陵並舊宅立廟，量加人灑掃，用展誠敬。

translations.literal: At the Wén Xuān tomb and the old residence establish a temple, measure and add persons for sweeping, to display sincere reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Temples at his tomb and birthplace were staffed for sweeping and reverence.

sentences.zh: 其後嗣可封文宣公。

translations.literal: His later heirs may be enfeoffed as Duke Wén Xuān.
translations.idiomatic: His descendants could hold the title Duke Wén Xuān.

sentences.zh: 至如辨方正位，著自禮經，苟非得所，何以示則？

translations.literal: As for distinguishing correct position and fixing place, it is set forth in the ritual classics—if one does not obtain the place, how show the model?
translations.idiomatic: Rites required correct placement to set a model.

sentences.zh: 昔緣周公南面，夫子西坐，今位既有殊，坐豈如舊，宜補其墜典，永作成式。

translations.literal: Formerly because the Duke of Zhou faced south and the Master sat west, now the positions already having difference, how can sitting be as of old? We should repair the fallen canon and eternally make it a form.
translations.idiomatic: The Master should face south like a king, not sit west as before the Duke of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，兩京國子監，夫子皆南面而坐，十哲等東西列侍。

translations.literal: From now onward at the Directorate of Studies in the two capitals the Master all faces south and sits; the Ten Wise and others attend east and west in rows.
translations.idiomatic: In both capitals Confucius was seated facing south with the Ten Wise flanking him.

sentences.zh: 天下諸州亦准此。

translations.literal: All prefectures under Heaven also follow this.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectures followed suit.

sentences.zh: 且門人三千，見稱十哲，包夫眾美，實越等夷。

translations.literal: Moreover among three thousand disciples those called the Ten Wise embraced the crowd's beauties and truly surpassed peers.
translations.idiomatic: The Ten Wise among three thousand disciples surpassed their peers.

sentences.zh: 暢玄聖之風規，發人倫之耳目，並宜褒贈，以寵賢明。

translations.literal: Expanding the dark sage's wind and rule, opening human relations' ears and eyes—all should be praised and enfeoffed to favor the worthy and bright.
translations.idiomatic: They should be honored to spread the sage's teaching and enlighten human relations.

sentences.zh: 顏子淵既雲亞聖，須優其秩，可贈兗公。

translations.literal: Yanzi Yuan already being called Second Sage must have his rank made superior; he may be enfeoffed as Duke of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Hui as Second Sage was enfeoffed as Duke of Yan.

sentences.zh: 閔子騫可贈費侯，冉伯牛可贈鄆侯，冉仲弓可贈薛侯，冉子有可贈徐侯，仲子路可贈衛侯，宰子我可贈齊侯，端木子貢可贈黎侯，言子游可贈吳侯，卜子夏可贈魏侯。

translations.literal: Min Ziqian may be enfeoffed as Marquis of Fei; Ran Boniu as Marquis of Yun; Ran Zhonggong as Marquis of Xue; Ran You as Marquis of Xu; Zhong Zilu as Marquis of Wei; Zai Wo as Marquis of Qi; Duanmu Zigong as Marquis of Li; Yan Ziyou as Marquis of Wu; Bu Zixia as Marquis of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Nine disciples received marquisates: Min, the three Rans, Zilu, Zai Wo, Zigong, Ziyou, and Zixia.

sentences.zh: 又夫子格言，參也稱魯，雖居七十之數，不載四科之目。

translations.literal: Moreover in the Master's succinct words Shen was called Lu; though he ranks among the seventy, he is not listed in the four categories.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius had called Zeng Shen "Lu"; he was among the seventy but not in the four categories.

sentences.zh: 頃雖異於十哲，終或殊於等倫，允稽先旨，俾循舊位。

translations.literal: Recently though differing from the Ten Wise, in the end perhaps differing from peers, we truly trace the former purport and cause him to follow the old position.
translations.idiomatic: Though not among the Ten Wise, Zeng Shen kept his former place by ancient precedent.

sentences.zh: 庶乎禮得其序，人焉式瞻，宗洙泗之丕烈，重膠庠之雅範。

translations.literal: Perhaps then ritual obtains its order, people have a model to gaze on, honoring the great glory of Zhu and Si and again weighting the elegant model of the school.
translations.idiomatic: Rite and example would honor Zhu-Si and the academy's tradition.

sentences.zh: 又贈曾參、顓孫師等六十七人皆為伯。

translations.literal: Also Zeng Shen, Zhuansun Shi, and sixty-seven others were all enfeoffed as earls.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty-seven more disciples, including Zeng Shen and Zhuansun Shi, became earls.

sentences.zh: 於是正宣父坐于南面，內出王者袞冕之服以衣之。

translations.literal: Thereupon they rectified the Venerable Father to sit facing south; from within came the king's robe and cap to clothe him.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius was seated facing south and clothed in royal robes.

sentences.zh: 遣尚書左丞相裴耀卿就國子廟冊贈文宣王。

translations.literal: They dispatched Left Chancellor of the Secretariat Pei Yaojing to the Directorate temple to confer patent enfeoffing King Wén Xuān.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yaojing conducted the enfeoffment at the Directorate temple.

sentences.zh: 冊畢，所司奠祭，亦如釋奠之儀，公卿已下預觀禮。

translations.literal: When the patent was concluded the relevant office set forth libation sacrifice, also like the libation ceremony; excellencies and below participated in observing the rites.
translations.idiomatic: After the patent, libation followed; officials down to the ranks watched.

sentences.zh: 又遣太子少保崔琳就東都廟以行冊禮，自是始用宮懸之樂。

translations.literal: They also dispatched Junior Protector to the Heir Apparent Cui Lin to the eastern-capital temple to perform the patent ceremony; from this they first used suspended palace music.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Lin performed the eastern-capital patent rite; palace music was introduced.

sentences.zh: 春秋二仲上丁，令三公攝行事。

translations.literal: At the upper ding days of the two mid-season months in spring and autumn, they ordered the Three Excellencies to act by commission.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn upper ding days: the Three Excellencies officiated by commission.

sentences.zh: 天寶元年，明經、進士習《爾雅》。

translations.literal: In Tianbao 1, mingjing and jinshi studied the Erya.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 1: mingjing and jinshi studied the Erya.

sentences.zh: 九載七月，國子監置廣文館，知進士業，博士、助教各一人，秩同太學博士。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year the Directorate established the Broad Culture Hall to oversee jinshi studies, one Erudite and one assistant instructor each, rank equal to the Grand Academy Erudite.
translations.idiomatic: Year 9: the Broad Culture Hall was added for jinshi with faculty equal to the Grand Academy.

sentences.zh: 十二載七月，詔天下舉人不得充鄉貢，皆補學生。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twelfth year an edict said candidates under Heaven may not fill local tribute quotas but all are to be supplemented as students.
translations.idiomatic: Year 12: examination candidates had to enroll as Directorate students, not as local tribute.

sentences.zh: 四門俊士停。

translations.literal: Four-gate distinguished scholars were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Four-gate distinguished scholars were abolished.

sentences.zh: 寶應二年六月，敕令州縣每歲察秀才孝廉，取鄉閭有孝悌廉恥之行薦焉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Baoying 2 an edict ordered prefectures and counties each year to examine xiucai and xiaolian, taking those of the village and district with conduct of filial piety, fraternal duty, integrity, and shame to recommend.
translations.idiomatic: Baoying 2: localities yearly recommended virtuous xiucai and xiaolian.

sentences.zh: 委有司以禮待之，試其所通之學，《五經》之內，精通一經，兼能對策，達於理體者，並量行業授官。

translations.literal: Entrust the relevant offices to treat them by ritual, examine the learning they have mastered; within the Five Classics, mastering one classic and also being able to answer policy, reaching the substance of principle—all are to be appointed office according to measured conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Offices tested one classic and policy; the qualified received offices by merit.

sentences.zh: 其明經、進士並停。

translations.literal: Mingjing and jinshi were both stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The mingjing and jinshi examinations were suspended.

sentences.zh: 國子學道舉，亦宜准此。

translations.literal: Directorate Daoist selection also should follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate moral selection followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 因楊綰之請也。

translations.literal: It was because of Yang Guan's request.
translations.idiomatic: This followed Yang Guan's memorial.

sentences.zh: 詔下朝臣集議，中書舍人賈至議，請依綰奏。

translations.literal: An edict was sent down for court ministers to assemble in discussion; Secretariat Drafter Jia Zhi deliberated and requested following Guan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhi urged adopting Yang Guan's plan.

sentences.zh: 有司奏曰：「竊以今年舉人等，或舊業既成，理難速改，或遠州所送，身已在途，事須收獎。

translations.literal: The relevant office memorialized: "We venture that this year's candidates and others, some having already completed old studies, in principle are hard to change quickly, or distant prefectures having sent them—their persons are already on the road; the affair must be accepted and rewarded."
translations.idiomatic: The ministry noted many candidates were already en route under the old rules.

sentences.zh: 其今秋舉人中有情願舊業舉試者，亦聽明年已後，一依新敕。

translations.literal: Among this autumn's candidates those who wish the old course and examination are also permitted from next year onward to follow the new edict entirely."
translations.idiomatic: This year's candidates could finish under the old rules; later years would follow the new edict.

sentences.zh: 」後綰議竟不行。

translations.literal: " Later Guan's deliberation in the end was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guan's reform was never enacted.

sentences.zh: 自至德後，兵革未息，國學生不能廩食，生徒盡散，堂墉頹壞，常借兵健居止。

translations.literal: From after Zhide, warfare not ceasing, Directorate students could not receive granary provisions, students and disciples all scattered, halls and walls collapsed in ruin, and they constantly borrowed military guards for lodging.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhide, war left the academy empty, ruined, and quartering soldiers.

sentences.zh: 至永泰二年正月，國子祭酒蕭昕上言：「崇儒尚學，以正風教，乃王化之本也。

translations.literal: By the first month of Yongtai 2, Directorate Libation-offering Director Xiao Xin submitted: "Honoring Ru and valuing learning to correct wind and teaching is the root of royal transformation."
translations.idiomatic: Yongtai 2: Director Xiao Xin urged reviving Confucian education as the basis of rule.

sentences.zh: 」其月二十九日，敕曰：

translations.literal: " On the twenty-ninth day of that month an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth the emperor responded:

sentences.zh: 理道同歸，師氏為上，化人成俗，必務於學。

translations.literal: Principle and the Way return together; the teacher corps is supreme; transforming people and completing custom must be zealous in learning.
translations.idiomatic: Teachers stood supreme; transforming custom required learning.

sentences.zh: 俊造之士，皆從此途，國之貴遊，罔不受業。

translations.literal: Outstanding candidates all follow this path; the state's noble sojourners none fail to receive instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Talented candidates and noble youths were to study.

sentences.zh: 修文行忠信之教，崇祗庸孝友之德，盡其師道，乃謂成人。

translations.literal: Cultivate the teaching of culture, conduct, loyalty, and trustworthiness; honor respectful service and filial-fraternal virtue; exhaust the teacher's Way—only then is one called adult.
translations.idiomatic: Classical virtue and the teacher's Way made the finished student.

sentences.zh: 兼復揚于王廷，考以政事，征之以禮，任之以官。

translations.literal: Moreover display at the royal court, examine by government affairs, summon by ritual, appoint by office.
translations.idiomatic: Graduates were to serve at court and enter office by merit.

sentences.zh: 置於周行，莫匪邦彥，樂得賢也，其在茲乎！

translations.literal: Placed in the Zhou ranks, none are not state elites; delighting in obtaining the worthy—it is here!
translations.idiomatic: The state would again delight in worthy men.

sentences.zh: 朕志求理體，尤重儒術，先王大教，敢不底行。

translations.literal: Our will seeks the substance of principle and especially weighs Ru learning; the former kings' great teaching—we dare not fail to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor prized learning and vowed to restore the sages' teaching.

sentences.zh: 頃以戎狄多難，急於經略，太學空設，諸生蓋寡。

translations.literal: Recently because the Rong and Di had many difficulties and we were urgent in strategy, the Grand Academy was set up empty and the various students were mostly few.
translations.idiomatic: War had emptied the Grand Academy.

sentences.zh: 弦誦之地，寂寥無聲，函丈之間，殆將不掃。

translations.literal: The place of string and recitation was desolate without sound; between the one-zhang teaching mat and the pupils it nearly would not be swept.
translations.idiomatic: Classrooms stood silent and untended.

sentences.zh: 上庠及此，甚用憫焉。

translations.literal: The upper academy reaching this—we deeply use pity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor lamented the academy's decay.

sentences.zh: 今宇縣攸甯，文武兼備，方投戈而講藝，俾釋菜而行禮。

translations.literal: Now the realm is at peace, civil and military both provided; we are just casting aside weapons to discuss arts, causing vegetable libation to proceed with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Peace returned; the court would lay aside arms for study and school rites.

sentences.zh: 四科鹹進，六藝復興，神人以和，風化浸美。

translations.literal: The four categories all advance, the six arts revive, spirits and men harmonize, and wind and transformation gradually beautify.
translations.idiomatic: The four disciplines and six arts would flourish again.

sentences.zh: 日用此道，將無間然。

translations.literal: Daily using this Way, there will be no gap.
translations.idiomatic: This Way would be practiced without interruption.

sentences.zh: 其諸道節度、觀察、都防禦使等，朕之腹心，久鎮方面。

translations.literal: The various circuit military commissioners, observers, and grand defense commissioners are our bosom kin, long garrisoning the regions.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were the emperor's trusted kin.

sentences.zh: 眷其子弟，各奉義方，修德立身，事資括羽。

translations.literal: Cherishing their sons and younger brothers, each upholds moral direction; cultivating virtue and establishing the person—the affair relies on training feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Their sons needed moral training and education.

sentences.zh: 恐干戈之後，學校尚微，僻居遠方，無所諮稟。

translations.literal: We fear that after spears and halberds schools are still slight, dwelling far in distant regions with nowhere to consult and receive instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Remote regions still lacked schools after the wars.

sentences.zh: 山東寡學，質疑必就于馬融；

translations.literal: East of the mountains learning is scarce; to resolve doubts one must go to Ma Rong;
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had few scholars; doubts once sent men to Ma Rong.

sentences.zh: 關西盛名，尊儒乃稱于楊震。

translations.literal: west of the pass has a famous reputation; honoring Ru is what Yang Zhen was called for.
translations.idiomatic: Guandong honored Ru as Yang Zhen had.

sentences.zh: 負經來學，當集京師。

translations.literal: Bearing classics to come study—they should assemble at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Students bearing classics should gather in the capital.

sentences.zh: 並宰相、朝官及神策六軍軍將子弟欲習業者，自今已後，並令補國子生。

translations.literal: Together with chancellors, court officers, and sons and younger brothers of the six Shence Army generals who wish to pursue studies—from now onward all are ordered to be supplemented as Directorate students.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers' and Shence generals' sons were ordered into the Directorate.

sentences.zh: 欲其業重籝金，器成琢玉，日新厥德，代不乏賢。

translations.literal: We wish their learning to weigh the casket's gold, their vessels to be completed like carved jade, daily renewing their virtue, generation after generation not lacking the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: They should refine talent like gold in a casket and jade on the wheel.

sentences.zh: 其中身雖有官，欲附學讀書者，亦聽。

translations.literal: Among them those who though holding office wish to attach to study and read books are also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Officials might also enroll to read books.

sentences.zh: 其學官，委中書、門下即簡擇行業堪為師範者充。

translations.literal: The academy officers—entrust the Secretariat and Chancellery immediately to select those whose conduct can serve as teacher models to fill the posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was to appoint worthy teachers.

sentences.zh: 學生員數多少，所習經業，考試等第，並所供糧料，及學館破壞，要量事修理，各委本司作條件聞奏。

translations.literal: Student quota numbers, classics studied, examination grades, provisions supplied, and damaged school buildings needing repair according to circumstances—all entrust each origin office to draft regulations and report.
translations.idiomatic: Each bureau was to report quotas, curricula, exams, rations, and repairs.

sentences.zh: 務須詳悉，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: The affair must be detailed and complete, matching our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Reports were to be thorough.

sentences.zh: 及二月朔上丁釋奠，蕭昕又奏：諸宰相元載、杜鴻漸、李抱玉及常參官、六軍軍將就國子學聽講論，賜錢五百貫。

translations.literal: At the first day of the second month, upper ding libation, Xiao Xin again memorialized: the various chancellors Yuan Zai, Du Hongjian, and Li Baoyu and regular-attendance officers and six-army generals came to the Directorate of Studies to hear lectures and discussion; five hundred strings of cash were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Second-month libation: chancellors and officers heard lectures at the Directorate; five hundred strings were granted.

sentences.zh: 令京兆尹黎幹造食。

translations.literal: They ordered the Governor of Jingzhao Li Gan to prepare food.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao Governor Li Gan provided the feast.

sentences.zh: 集諸儒、道、僧，質問竟日。

translations.literal: They assembled the various Ru, Dao, and Buddhist masters and questioned meanings the whole day.
translations.idiomatic: Ru, Daoist, and Buddhist masters debated all day.

sentences.zh: 此禮久廢，一朝能舉。

translations.literal: This rite had long been abandoned; in one morning it could be raised.
translations.idiomatic: A long-abandoned rite was revived in a day.

sentences.zh: 八月，國子學成祠堂、論堂、六館及官吏所居廳宇，用錢四萬貫，拆曲江亭子瓦木助之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Directorate of Studies completed the ancestral hall, lecture hall, six institutes, and the office chambers where officials dwelt, using forty thousand strings of cash; they dismantled the Qujiang Pavilion's tiles and timber to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the academy rebuilt its halls for forty thousand strings, using timber from the Qujiang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 四日，釋奠，宰相、常參官、軍將盡會於講堂，京兆府置食，講論。

translations.literal: On the fourth day, libation; chancellors, regular-attendance officers, and generals all met in the lecture hall; Jingzhao prefecture set out food and lectured.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth day libation: officials feasted and debated in the lecture hall.

sentences.zh: 軍容使魚朝恩說《易》，又於論堂畫《周易》鏡圖。

translations.literal: Army Commissioner Yu Chaoen lectured on the Changes, and also in the lecture hall painted the "Mirror Diagram of the Zhou Changes."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chaoen lectured on the Changes and painted its Mirror Diagram.

sentences.zh: 自至德二載收兩京，唯元正含元殿受朝賀，設宮懸之樂，雖郊廟大祭，只有登歌樂，亦無文、武二舞。

translations.literal: From Zhide 2 when the two capitals were recovered, only at New Year's the Hall of Enlightened Governance received court congratulation and set palace suspended music; even suburban and temple great sacrifices had only ascending hymn music, and also lacked civil and martial two dances.
translations.idiomatic: Since recovering the capitals in 757, full court music was rare even at great sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 其時軍容使魚朝恩知監事，廟庭乃具宮懸之樂於講堂前，又有教坊樂府雜會，竟日而罷。

translations.literal: At that time Army Commissioner Yu Chaoen knew supervision affairs; the temple courtyard then had complete palace suspended music before the lecture hall, and also the Music Bureau of the Instructional Workshop mixed performances, ending at sunset.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chaoen staged full palace music and entertainments at the academy all day.

sentences.zh: 二十五日，詔曰：「古者設官分土，所以崇德報功。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day an edict said: "In antiquity establishing offices and dividing lands was to honor virtue and repay merit."
translations.idiomatic: Day 25: an edict praised merit and office.

sentences.zh: 總內署之綱，事密於清禁；

translations.literal: Presiding over the inner precinct's main cords, affairs are secret within the pure forbidden precinct;
translations.idiomatic: He governed the inner palace with secret care;

sentences.zh: 弘上庠之教，德潤於鴻業。

translations.literal: expanding the upper academy's teaching, virtue moistens the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: and expanded the academy, enriching the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 賦開千乘，禮序九賓。

translations.literal: Fief opening a thousand chariots, ritual ordering the nine guests.
translations.idiomatic: His fief was vast; ritual ranked him among nine guests.

sentences.zh: 必資兼濟之能，用協至公之選。

translations.literal: One must rely on ability that assists both sides, using it to harmonize the selection of utmost fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Such breadth required a man of balanced talent.

sentences.zh: 開府儀同三司、兼右監門衛大將軍、仍知觀軍容宣慰處置使、知內侍省事、內飛龍閑廄使，內弓箭庫使、知神策軍兵馬使、上柱國、馮翊郡開國公魚朝恩，溫良恭儉，寬柔簡廉，長才博達，敏識高妙。

translations.literal: Kaifu Yitong Sansi, concurrent Right Supervisor of the Gate Guards Grand General, still knowing Army Commissioner for Observation, Pacification, and Disposition, knowing Inner Palace Service Director, Inner Flying Dragon Stud Director, Inner Bow and Arrow Store Director, knowing Shence Army Horse Commissioner, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Fenyang in Fengyi commandery Yu Chaoen—gentle, good, respectful, and frugal, broad, soft, simple, and incorrupt, long in talent and broad in reach, keen in knowledge and lofty in subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: The edict extolled Yu Chaoen's titles, virtues, and talents at length.

sentences.zh: 學究儒玄之秘，謀窮遁甲之精。

translations.literal: Learning exhausted the secrets of Ru and dark studies; stratagems exhausted the essence of escape armor.
translations.idiomatic: He was learned in Confucian and esoteric texts and military divination.

sentences.zh: 百行資身，一心奉上。

translations.literal: A hundred conduct lines supported his person; one mind served above.
translations.idiomatic: His conduct supported the throne.

sentences.zh: 自王室多故，雲雷經始，五原之北，以先啟行；

translations.literal: From when the royal house had many troubles and cloud-thunder began the enterprise, north of Wuyuan he was first to open the march;
translations.idiomatic: Since the rebellion he had marched first from Wuyuan;

sentences.zh: 三河之表，爰整其旅。

translations.literal: south of the three rivers he thereupon arrayed his brigades.
translations.idiomatic: and organized armies south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 成師必勝，每合於韜鈐；

translations.literal: Completing the army must win—each time matching the military canon;
translations.idiomatic: His armies won by classic strategy;

sentences.zh: 料敵無遺，可征于蓍蔡。

translations.literal: calculating the enemy without omission—can be verified in yarrow and tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: his foresight matched divination.

sentences.zh: 關洛既定，幽燕復開，海外有截，厥功惟茂。

translations.literal: When Guan and Luo were settled and You and Yan again opened, overseas there was cutting off—his merit alone was luxuriant.
translations.idiomatic: He had helped pacify the heartland and frontiers.

sentences.zh: 曆事三聖，始終竭力。

translations.literal: Serving three sagely rulers, from beginning to end exerting strength.
translations.idiomatic: He had served three emperors faithfully.

sentences.zh: 頃東都扈蹕，釋位勤王，時當綴旒，節見披棘，下江助我，甲令先書，社稷之衛，邦家是賴。

translations.literal: Recently escorting the eastern capital, releasing position to assist the king—when the time was like a fallen pearl and the season saw brambles parted, descending the river to aid us, armor orders written first—the guard of the altars of soil and grain, the state and family rely on this.
translations.idiomatic: He had escorted the court east and aided the throne in crisis.

sentences.zh: 及邊陲罷警，戎務解嚴，方獎勵于《易》象。

translations.literal: When the frontier ceased alarm and military affairs relaxed vigilance, we then were rewarding him in the Images of the Changes."
translations.idiomatic: With peace returning, the court now rewarded his study of the Changes.

sentences.zh: 才兼文武，所謂勳賢，亦既任能，斯焉命賞，宜膺朝典，式副公議。

translations.literal: Talent joining civil and martial—what is called meritorious worthy; also already appointing by ability—here then is the mandate of reward; he should receive court canon and match public deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: His civil and military merit deserved high office by public acclaim.

sentences.zh: 可行內侍監，判國子監事，充鴻臚禮賓等使，封鄭國公，食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: He may act as Inner Service Director, acting Directorate of Studies affairs, filling Honglu ritual-guest and related commissioner posts, enfeoffed as Duke of Zheng with a fief of three thousand households."
translations.idiomatic: He was made Inner Service Director, acting Directorate head, Duke of Zheng, fief 3000.

sentences.zh: 」二十四日，於國子監上。

translations.literal: " On the twenty-fourth day, at the Directorate of Studies.
translations.idiomatic: The patent was issued at the Directorate on the twenty-fourth.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相及中書門下官、諸司常參官、六軍軍將送上。

translations.literal: An edict ordered chancellors and Secretariat-Chancellery officers, various departments' regular-attendance officers, and six-army generals to escort him up.
translations.idiomatic: Officials escorted him to the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 京兆府造食，內教坊音樂、竿木渾脫，羅列於論堂前。

translations.literal: Jingzhao prefecture prepared food; inner Instructional Workshop music, pole puppets, and swerving puppets were arrayed before the lecture hall.
translations.idiomatic: A feast and palace entertainments filled the lecture hall.

sentences.zh: 朝恩辭以中官不合知南衙曹務，宰相、僕射、大夫皆勸之，朝恩固辭，乃奏之。

translations.literal: Chaoen declined on the ground that inner attendants should not know southern-yamen administrative affairs; chancellors, vice premiers, and grandees all urged him, but Chaoen firmly declined and then memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chaoen declined civil office; ministers urged him in vain.

sentences.zh: 宰相引就食。

translations.literal: The chancellor led him to the food.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor led him to the feast.

sentences.zh: 奏樂，中使送酒及茶果，賜充宴樂，竟日而罷。

translations.literal: Music was played; inner envoys sent wine and tea and fruit, bestowed to supply banquet music, ending at sunset.
translations.idiomatic: Music, imperial wine, and fruit lasted until sunset.

sentences.zh: 元載奏狀。

translations.literal: Yuan Zai memorialized a report.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zai submitted a memorial.

sentences.zh: 又使中使宣敕云：「朝恩既辭不止，但任知學生糧料。

translations.literal: They also had an inner envoy proclaim an edict: "Since Chaoen having declined does not stop, let him only be charged with knowing students' grain provisions."
translations.idiomatic: An envoy limited his charge to student provisions.

sentences.zh: 」是日，宰相軍將已下子弟三百餘人，皆衣紫衣，充學生房，設食於廊下。

translations.literal: " That day, more than three hundred sons and younger brothers of chancellors and generals and below all wore purple robes, filling student quarters; food was set in the corridors.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred officials' sons in purple filled the student quarters.

sentences.zh: 貸錢一萬貫，五分收錢，以供監官學生之費。

translations.literal: A loan of ten thousand strings of cash, collecting five percent interest, to supply Directorate officers and students' expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand strings were lent at five percent for academy expenses.

sentences.zh: 俄又請青苗地頭取百文資課以供費同。

translations.literal: Soon he also requested taking a hundred cash per green-sprout land head as assessment to supply expenses likewise.
translations.idiomatic: He soon added a levy on green-sprout land.

sentences.zh: 舊例，兩京國子監生二千餘人，弘文館、崇文館、崇玄館學生，皆廩飼之。

translations.literal: By old precedent the two-capital Directorate had more than two thousand students; Hongwen, Chongwen, and Chongxuan institute students were all granary-fed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly over two thousand capital students received state rations.

sentences.zh: 十五載，上都失守，此事廢絕。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the upper capital was lost and this affair was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The An Lushan rebellion ended the provision.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年，以兵革未息，又詔罷州縣學生，以俟豐歲。

translations.literal: In Qianyuan 1, because warfare had not ceased, another edict stopped prefectural and county students, to await a plentiful year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianyuan 1: local schools were closed until peace.

sentences.zh: 則天垂拱四年四月，雍州永安人唐同泰偽造瑞石于洛水，獻之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Empress Zetian's Chui Gong 4, Yong Prefecture's Yong'an man Tang Tongtai forged an auspicious stone in the Luo River and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Chui Gong 4: Tang Tongtai forged a "auspicious stone" in the Luo.

sentences.zh: 其文曰：「聖母臨人，永昌帝業。

translations.literal: Its text said: "The Holy Mother oversees men; eternal flourishing of the imperial enterprise."
translations.idiomatic: It read: "The Holy Mother rules mankind; the dynasty flourishes forever."

sentences.zh: 」於是號其石為「寶圖」，賜百官宴樂，賜物有差。

translations.literal: Thereupon they styled the stone "Treasure Chart," bestowed banquet music on the hundred officials, and bestowed goods in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: The stone was named Treasure Chart; officials were feasted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 授同泰為遊擊將軍。

translations.literal: Tongtai was appointed General of Guerrilla Warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Tongtai became a guerrilla general.

sentences.zh: 其年五月下制，欲親拜洛受「寶圖。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year an edict was issued wishing personally to bow at the Luo and receive the "Treasure Chart."
translations.idiomatic: That fifth month she planned to worship at the Luo and receive the chart.

sentences.zh: 」先有事於南郊，告謝昊天上帝。

translations.literal: " First perform the affair at the southern suburb and announce thanks to August Lord on High."
translations.idiomatic: She would first sacrifice at the southern suburb to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 令諸州都督、刺史並諸親，並以拜洛前十日集神都。

translations.literal: Order all circuit governors, prefects, and various kin all to assemble at the divine capital ten days before bowing at the Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Governors, prefects, and kin were summoned to Luoyang beforehand.

sentences.zh: 於是則天加尊號為聖母神皇。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zetian added the honorific title Holy Mother Divine Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian took the title Holy Mother Divine Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: She proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 改「寶圖」為「天授聖圖」，洛水為永昌。

translations.literal: The name "Precious Chart" was changed to "Chart Bestowed by Heaven," and the Luo River to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: "Precious Chart" became "Chart Bestowed by Heaven," and the Luo River was renamed Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 封其神為顯聖侯，加特進，禁漁釣，祭享齊於四瀆。

translations.literal: Its spirit was enfeoffed as Marquis of Manifest Sagacity, granted special advancement, fishing was forbidden, and its sacrifices were made equal to those of the Four Streams.
translations.idiomatic: Its spirit was made Marquis of Manifest Sagacity with special advancement; fishing was banned; sacrifices ranked with the Four Streams.

sentences.zh: 所出處號曰聖圖泉，於泉側置永昌縣。

translations.literal: The place where it issued forth was called the Spring of the Sacred Chart, and Yongchang County was established beside the spring.
translations.idiomatic: The source was named Spring of the Sacred Chart; Yongchang County was set up beside it.

sentences.zh: 又以嵩山與洛水接近，因改嵩山為神嶽，授太師、使持節、神岳大都督、天中王，禁斷芻牧。

translations.literal: Because Mount Song was near the Luo River, Mount Song was changed to Divine Peak; it was granted Grand Preceptor, bearer of the staff of authority, Grand Commander of the Divine Peak, and King of the Center of Heaven; pasturage was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: As Mount Song lay near the Luo, it was renamed Divine Peak, titled Grand Preceptor, bearer of the staff of authority, Grand Commander of the Divine Peak, and King of the Center of Heaven, with pasturage forbidden.

sentences.zh: 其天中王及顯聖侯，並為置廟。

translations.literal: For the King of the Center of Heaven and the Marquis of Manifest Sagacity, temples were both established.
translations.idiomatic: Temples were established for both the King of the Center of Heaven and the Marquis of Manifest Sagacity.

sentences.zh: 又先于汜水得瑞石，因改汜水縣為廣武縣。

translations.literal: Earlier a propitious stone had also been obtained at Sishui, and Sishui County was therefore changed to Guangwu County.
translations.idiomatic: A propitious stone had earlier been found at Sishui, so Sishui County was renamed Guangwu.

sentences.zh: 至其年十二月，則天親拜洛受圖，為壇于洛水之北，中橋之左。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year the Empress Wu personally performed the Luo worship to receive the chart, erecting an altar north of the Luo River, to the left of the Central Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That twelfth month Wu Zetian personally worshipped at the Luo to receive the chart, building an altar north of the Luo, left of the Central Bridge.

sentences.zh: 皇太子皆從。

translations.literal: The crown prince and all others followed.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince followed, and all others with him.

sentences.zh: 內外文武在僚、蠻夷酋長，各依方位而立。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without, and chieftains of the barbarians, each stood according to their direction.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials and barbarian chieftains each stood by their assigned direction.

sentences.zh: 珍禽奇獸，並列於壇前。

translations.literal: Rare birds and strange beasts were all arrayed before the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Rare birds and strange beasts were arrayed before the altar.

sentences.zh: 文物鹵簿，自有唐已來，未有如此之盛者也。

translations.literal: Ritual vessels and insignia escort—since Tang began, there had never been such magnificence.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual vessels and escort insignia had never been so magnificent since the Tang began.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，即日還宮。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, they returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites ended, they returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 神都父老勒碑於拜洛壇前，號曰：「天授聖圖之表。

translations.literal: The elders of the Divine Capital carved a stele before the Luo-worship altar, entitled "Tablet of the Chart Bestowed by Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: Divine Capital elders carved a stele before the Luo-worship altar, titled "Tablet of the Chart Bestowed by Heaven."

sentences.zh: 」開元五年，左補闕盧履冰上言曰：「則天皇后拜洛受圖壇及碑文，雲垂拱四年唐同泰得石，文雲'聖母臨人，永昌帝業'之所建。

translations.literal: " In Kaiyuan year 5, Left Remonstrance Lu Lübing submitted: "The altar and stele inscription for Empress Wu's Luo worship to receive the chart were erected where, in the fourth year of Chuigong, Tang Tongtai obtained the stone whose text read 'The Holy Mother oversees the people; the Yongchang imperial enterprise.'"
translations.idiomatic: " Kaiyuan 5: Left Remonstrance Lu Lübing said the altar and stele for Wu Zetian's Luo chart worship were built where Tang Tongtai found the Chuigong 4 stone reading "The Holy Mother oversees the people; the Yongchang imperial enterprise."

sentences.zh: 因改元為永昌，仍置永昌縣。

translations.literal: The era name was therefore changed to Yongchang, and Yongchang County was still established.
translations.idiomatic: The era was renamed Yongchang and Yongchang County was established.

sentences.zh: 縣既尋廢，同泰亦已貶官，唯碑壇獨立。

translations.literal: The county was soon abolished and Tongtai had already been demoted; only the stele and altar stood alone.
translations.idiomatic: The county was soon abolished and Tongtai demoted; only stele and altar remained.

sentences.zh: 准天樞、頌台之例，不可更留。

translations.literal: Following the precedent of the Heavenly Pivot and Praise Terrace, they could not be left standing.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Heavenly Pivot and Praise Terrace precedent, they could not remain.

sentences.zh: 」始令所司毀之，其顯聖侯廟亦尋毀拆。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the responsible offices were ordered to destroy them, and the temple of the Marquis of Manifest Sagacity was soon torn down as well.
translations.idiomatic: " The offices were ordered to destroy them; the Marquis of Manifest Sagacity temple was soon demolished.

sentences.zh: 開元二十九年正月己丑，詔兩京及諸州各置玄元皇帝廟一所，並置崇玄學。

translations.literal: In the first month, jichou, of Kaiyuan year 29, an edict ordered one temple to the August Ancestor Emperor of the Mysterious Origin in each of the Two Capitals and every prefecture, and the establishment of the Chongxuan Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 29, first month, jichou: edict ordered one August Ancestor of the Mysterious Origin temple per Two Capital and prefecture, plus Chongxuan academies.

sentences.zh: 其生徒令習《道德經》及《莊子》、《列子》、《文子》等，每年准明經例舉送。

translations.literal: Students were ordered to study the Classic of the Way and Its Virtue, Zhuangzi, Liezi, Wenzi, and the like, and each year were presented for examination following the mingjing precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Students were to study the Daodejing, Zhuangzi, Liezi, Wenzi, and the like, presented yearly by mingjing precedent.

sentences.zh: 至閏四月，玄宗夢京師城南山趾有天尊之像，求得之于盩厔樓觀之側。

translations.literal: By the intercalary fourth month, Xuanzong dreamed that at the southern foot of the capital city wall there was an image of the Heavenly Honored One, and it was obtained beside the Louguan in Zhouzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month Xuanzong dreamed of a Heavenly Honored image at the capital's southern wall; it was found beside Zhouzhi's Louguan.

sentences.zh: 至天寶元年正月癸丑，陳王府參軍田同秀稱於京永昌街空中見玄元皇帝，以「天下太平，聖壽無疆」之言傳于玄宗，仍雲桃林縣故關令尹喜宅傍有靈寶符。

translations.literal: In the first month, guichou, of Tianbao year 1, Tian Tongxiu, adjutant of the Prince of Chen's household, said that in the air over Yongchang Street in the capital he had seen the August Ancestor Emperor of the Mysterious Origin, conveying to Xuanzong the words "All under Heaven is at peace; may Your Sagely Longevity be without limit," and also that beside the former residence of the Pass Director Yin Xi at Taolin County there was a numinous treasure talisman.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 1, first month, guichou: Chen-household adjutant Tian Tongxiu said he saw the August Ancestor of the Mysterious Origin over Yongchang Street, bearing "All under Heaven at peace; sagely longevity without limit," and that a numinous treasure talisman lay by Yin Xi's old Taolin residence.

sentences.zh: 發使求之，十七日，獻於含元殿。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to seek it; on the seventeenth day it was presented at Hanyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent; on the seventeenth it was presented at Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 於是置玄元廟于太寧坊，東都於積善坊舊邸。

translations.literal: Thereupon a temple to the Mysterious Origin was set up in Taiping Ward; in the Eastern Capital, at the old residence in Jishan Ward.
translations.idiomatic: A Mysterious Origin temple was set in Taiping Ward; in the Eastern Capital, at the old Jishan residence.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，禦含元殿，加尊號為開元天寶聖文神武皇帝。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the second month he attended Hanyuan Hall and added the honorific title Emperor Sagely in Culture and Martial in Kaiyuan and Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: at Hanyuan Hall he took the honorific Sagely in Culture and Martial Emperor of Kaiyuan and Tianbao.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，親祔玄元廟。

translations.literal: On xinmao he personally enshrined tablets at the Mysterious Origin temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he personally installed spirit tablets at the Mysterious Origin temple.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔：《古今人表》，玄元皇帝升入上聖。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict ordered: in the Table of Notable Men Past and Present, the August Ancestor Emperor of the Mysterious Origin was advanced to upper sage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen: in the Table of Notable Men Past and Present, the August Ancestor of the Mysterious Origin was raised to upper sage.

sentences.zh: 莊子號南華真人，文子號通玄真人，列子號沖虛真人，庚桑子號洞虛真人。

translations.literal: Zhuangzi was titled Perfected Man of Southern Florescence; Wenzi, Perfected Man of Penetrating Mystery; Liezi, Perfected Man of Empty Transit; Gengsangzi, Perfected Man of Cavernous Mystery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzi became Perfected Man of Southern Florescence; Wenzi, of Penetrating Mystery; Liezi, of Empty Transit; Gengsangzi, of Cavernous Mystery.

sentences.zh: 改《莊子》為《南華真經》，《文子》為《通玄真經》，《列子》為《沖虛真經》，《庚桑子》為《洞虛真經》。

translations.literal: Zhuangzi was changed to the True Classic of Southern Florescence; Wenzi to the True Classic of Penetrating Mystery; Liezi to the True Classic of Empty Transit; Gengsangzi to the True Classic of Cavernous Mystery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzi became the True Classic of Southern Florescence; Wenzi, of Penetrating Mystery; Liezi, of Empty Transit; Gengsangzi, of Cavernous Mystery.

sentences.zh: 亳州真源縣先天太后及玄元廟各置令一人。

translations.literal: At Zhenyuan County in Bozhou, one magistrate each was appointed for the Primordial Heaven Empress Dowager and the Mysterious Origin temple.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou's Zhenyuan County: one magistrate each for the Primordial Heaven Empress Dowager and the Mysterious Origin temple.

sentences.zh: 兩京崇玄學各置博士、助教，又置學生一百員。

translations.literal: Each Chongxuan Academy in the Two Capitals was given erudites and assistant instructors, and one hundred students were also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Each Two-Capital Chongxuan Academy received erudites and assistants plus one hundred students.

sentences.zh: 桃林縣改為靈寶縣。

translations.literal: Taolin County was changed to Lingbao County.
translations.idiomatic: Taolin County was renamed Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 田同秀與五品官。

translations.literal: Tian Tongxiu was given fifth-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Tongxiu was appointed to fifth-rank office.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔崇文習《道德經》。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, an edict ordered the Chongwen Academy to study the Classic of the Way and Its Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: edict ordered Chongwen students to study the Daodejing.

sentences.zh: 七月，隴西李氏敦煌、姑臧、絳郡、武陽四房隸于宗正寺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the four branches of the Longxi Li—Dunhuang, Guzang, Jiang commandery, and Wuyang—were placed under the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Longxi Li branches Dunhuang, Guzang, Jiang, and Wuyang were placed under the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 九月，兩京玄元廟改為太上玄元廟，天下准此。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Mysterious Origin temples in the Two Capitals were changed to Supreme August Mysterious Origin temples; all under Heaven followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Two-Capital Mysterious Origin temples became Supreme August Mysterious Origin temples; the empire followed.

sentences.zh: 十月，改新豐驪山為會昌山，仍于秦坑儒之所立祠宇。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Xinfeng's Mount Li was changed to Mount Huichang, and a shrine was still erected at the place where the Qin buried the scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Xinfeng's Mount Li became Mount Huichang; a shrine was erected at the Qin scholars' burial site.

sentences.zh: 新作長生殿改為集靈台。

translations.literal: The newly built Hall of Long Life was changed to the Terrace of Gathering Spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The new Hall of Long Life became the Terrace of Gathering Spirits.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙辰，加玄元皇帝尊號「大聖祖」三字，崇玄學改為崇玄館，博士為學士，助教為直學士，更置大學士員。

translations.literal: In the first month, bingchen, of year 2, three characters "Great Sagely Ancestor" were added to the August Ancestor's honorific; Chongxuan Academy became Chongxuan Lodge; erudites became academicians; assistant instructors became direct academicians; grand academician posts were added.
translations.idiomatic: Year 2, first month, bingchen: "Great Sagely Ancestor" was added to the honorific; Chongxuan Academy became Lodge; erudites became academicians; assistants, direct academicians; grand academicians were added.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，親謁玄元宮，聖祖母益壽氏號先天太后，仍于譙郡置廟。

translations.literal: In the third month, renzi, he personally visited the Mysterious Origin palace; the sagely grandmother, the Yishou clan, was titled Primordial Heaven Empress Dowager, and a temple was still set up in Qiao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renzi: he visited the Mysterious Origin palace; grandmother Yishou became Primordial Heaven Empress Dowager; a temple was set in Qiao.

sentences.zh: 尊皋繇為德明皇帝，涼武昭王為興聖皇帝。

translations.literal: Gao Yao was honored as Emperor of Manifest Virtue; the Martial and Illustrious King of Liang as Emperor of Rising Sagacity.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yao was honored as Emperor of Manifest Virtue; Liang's Martial Illustrious King as Emperor of Rising Sagacity.

sentences.zh: 西京玄元廟為太清宮，東京為太微宮，天下諸州為紫極宮。

translations.literal: The Western Capital Mysterious Origin temple became the Supreme Clarity Palace; the Eastern Capital's, the Supreme Subtlety Palace; those in prefectures throughout the realm, Purple Ultimate palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Western Capital's temple became Supreme Clarity Palace; Eastern Capital's, Supreme Subtlety; prefectural temples, Purple Ultimate palaces.

sentences.zh: 九月，譙郡紫極宮宜准西京為太清宮，先天太皇及太后廟亦並改為宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Purple Ultimate palace in Qiao commandery should follow the Western Capital as Supreme Clarity Palace; temples of the Primordial Heaven Grand Emperor and Empress Dowager were also changed to palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Qiao's Purple Ultimate palace was to match the Western Capital as Supreme Clarity; Primordial Heaven emperor and empress temples became palaces.

sentences.zh: 三載三月，兩京及天下諸郡於開元觀、開元寺，以金銅鑄玄元等身天尊及佛各一軀。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 3, in Kaiyuan abbeys and Kaiyuan temples in the Two Capitals and every commandery under Heaven, one golden-bronze image each of the Mysterious Origin in true stature as Heavenly Honored One and of the Buddha was cast.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, third month: in Kaiyuan abbeys and temples empire-wide, one gilt-bronze Mysterious Origin Heavenly Honored image and one Buddha each were cast.

sentences.zh: 七載二月，于大同殿修功德處，玉芝兩莖生於柱礎上。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 7, at the merit site where merit was cultivated in Datong Hall, two stems of jade fungus grew on the column base.
translations.idiomatic: Year 7, second month: at Datong Hall's merit site, two jade fungus stems grew on a column base.

sentences.zh: 五月，玄宗禦興慶殿，授冊尊號曰開元天寶聖文神武應道皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Xuanzong attended Xingqing Hall and received a patent of honorific title as Emperor Sagely in Culture and Martial, Responsive to the Way, of Kaiyuan and Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: at Xingqing Hall Xuanzong received the honorific Sagely in Culture and Martial, Responsive to the Way, Emperor of Kaiyuan and Tianbao.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以玄元皇帝見於朝元閣，改為降聖閣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, because the August Ancestor Emperor of the Mysterious Origin appeared at Chaoyuan Pavilion, it was changed to the Pavilion of Descending Sagacity.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: as the August Ancestor appeared at Chaoyuan Pavilion, it became the Pavilion of Descending Sagacity.

sentences.zh: 改會昌縣為昭應縣，改會昌山為昭應山。

translations.literal: Huichang County was changed to Zhaoying County; Mount Huichang to Mount Zhaoying.
translations.idiomatic: Huichang County became Zhaoying; Mount Huichang, Mount Zhaoying.

sentences.zh: 封昭應山神為玄德公，立祠宇。

translations.literal: The spirit of Mount Zhaoying was enfeoffed as Duke of Mysterious Virtue, and a shrine was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Zhaoying's spirit was enfeoffed Duke of Mysterious Virtue; a shrine was built.

sentences.zh: 初，太清宮成，命工人于太白山采白石，為玄元聖容，又采白石為玄宗聖容，侍立于玄元之右。

translations.literal: Initially, when the Supreme Clarity Palace was completed, workers were sent to Mount Taibai to quarry white stone for the sacred image of the Mysterious Origin, and white stone was also taken for Xuanzong's sacred image, standing in attendance to the right of the Mysterious Origin.
translations.idiomatic: When the Supreme Clarity Palace was finished, Taibai workers quarried white stone for the Mysterious Origin's image and for Xuanzong's, standing at the Mysterious Origin's right.

sentences.zh: 皆依王者袞冕之服，繒彩珠玉為之。

translations.literal: Both wore kingly robes and caps of the highest grade, made of silk, colors, pearls, and jade.
translations.idiomatic: Both wore supreme kingly robes and caps of silk, color, pearl, and jade.

sentences.zh: 又于像設東刻白石為李林甫、陳希烈之形。

translations.literal: East of the image setting, white stone was carved into the forms of Li Linfu and Chen Xilie.
translations.idiomatic: East of the images, white stone figures of Li Linfu and Chen Xilie were carved.

sentences.zh: 及林甫犯事，又刻石為楊國忠之形，而瘞林甫之石。

translations.literal: When Linfu offended, stone was again carved for Yang Guozhong's form, and Linfu's stone was buried.
translations.idiomatic: When Linfu fell, Guozhong's stone was carved and Linfu's buried.

sentences.zh: 及希烈、國忠貶，盡毀瘞之。

translations.literal: When Xilie and Guozhong were demoted, all were destroyed and buried.
translations.idiomatic: When Xilie and Guozhong fell, every stone was destroyed and buried.

sentences.zh: 八載六月，玉芝產於大同殿。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year 8, jade fungus appeared at Datong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Year 8, sixth month: jade fungus appeared at Datong Hall.

sentences.zh: 先是，太白山人李渾稱于金星洞仙人見，語老人雲，有玉版石記符「聖上長生久視。

translations.literal: Earlier, Li Hun of Mount Taibai said that in the Golden Star Grotto a transcendent had been seen, telling an old man that there was a jade-plaque stone record talisman: "May the Sagely Lord enjoy long life and far sight.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Taibai's Li Hun said a transcendent at Golden Star Grotto told an elder of a jade-plaque record: "May the Sagely Lord enjoy long life and far sight.

sentences.zh: 」令御史中丞王鉷入山洞，求而得之。

translations.literal: " The Censor-in-Chief Wang Qiong was ordered to enter the mountain grotto and obtained it.
translations.idiomatic: " Censor-in-Chief Wang Qiong entered the grotto and obtained it.

sentences.zh: 閏六月四日，玄宗朝太清宮，加聖祖玄元皇帝尊號曰聖祖大道玄元皇帝，高祖、太宗、高宗、中宗、睿宗尊號並加「大聖」字，皇后並加「順聖」字。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the intercalary sixth month, Xuanzong attended the Supreme Clarity Palace and added to the Sagely Ancestor August Ancestor's honorific the title Sagely Ancestor Great Way August Ancestor Emperor of the Mysterious Origin; to Gaozu, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong the character "Great Sagely" was added; to the empresses, "Obedient Sagely."
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month, day 4: at Supreme Clarity Palace the Sagely Ancestor's honorific became Sagely Ancestor Great Way August Ancestor of the Mysterious Origin; Gaozu through Ruizong gained "Great Sagely"; empresses, "Obedient Sagely."

sentences.zh: 五日，玄宗禦含元殿，加尊號曰開元天寶聖文神武應道皇帝。

translations.literal: On the fifth day, Xuanzong attended Hanyuan Hall and added the honorific title Emperor Sagely in Culture and Martial, Responsive to the Way, of Kaiyuan and Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: Day 5: at Hanyuan Hall he took the honorific Sagely in Culture and Martial, Responsive to the Way, Emperor of Kaiyuan and Tianbao.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: There was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: There was a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，每至禘祫，並于太清宮聖祖前設位序昭穆。

translations.literal: From now on, whenever the di and xia seasonal sacrifices came, seats in zhao-mu order were set before the Sagely Ancestor in the Supreme Clarity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth at each di and xia sacrifice, zhao-mu seats were set before the Sagely Ancestor at Supreme Clarity Palace.

sentences.zh: 太白山封神應公，金星洞改嘉祥洞，所管華陽縣改為真符縣。

translations.literal: Mount Taibai's spirit was enfeoffed Duke of Responsive Blessing; Golden Star Grotto was changed to Auspicious Felicity Grotto; Huayang County under its jurisdiction was changed to Zhenfu County.
translations.idiomatic: Taibai's spirit became Duke of Responsive Blessing; Golden Star Grotto, Auspicious Felicity Grotto; Huayang County, Zhenfu.

sentences.zh: 兩京及十道一大郡，置真符玉芝觀。

translations.literal: In the Two Capitals and one great commandery in each of the ten circuits, a Zhenfu Jade Fungus Abbey was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhenfu Jade Fungus Abbey was set in each Two Capital and one great commandery per circuit.

sentences.zh: 九載十月，先是，御史大夫王鉷奏稱太白山人王玄翼見玄元皇帝于寶山洞中。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year 9, earlier, Censor-in-Chief Wang Qiong memorialized that Wang Xuanyi of Mount Taibai had seen the August Ancestor Emperor of the Mysterious Origin in a treasure mountain grotto.
translations.idiomatic: Year 9, tenth month: earlier Censor-in-Chief Wang Qiong said Taibai's Wang Xuanyi saw the August Ancestor in a treasure grotto.

sentences.zh: 乃遣王鉷、張均、王倕、韋濟、王翼、王岳靈於洞中得玉石函《上清護國經》、寶券、紀籙等，獻之。

translations.literal: Wang Qiong, Zhang Jun, Wang Wei, Wei Ji, Wang Yi, and Wang Yueling were then sent into the grotto and obtained a jade-and-stone casket containing the Classic of Upper Clarity for Protecting the State, treasure tallies, registers, and the like, which were presented.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiong, Zhang Jun, Wang Wei, Wei Ji, Wang Yi, and Wang Yueling entered the grotto and obtained a jade casket with the Upper Clarity Classic for Protecting the State, tallies, registers, and the like, and presented them.

sentences.zh: 十一月，制：「承前宗廟，皆稱告享。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, an ordinance stated: "Formerly the ancestral temple sacrifices were all called reporting and offering.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: ordinance said, "Formerly ancestral sacrifices were called reporting and offering.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，每親告獻太清、太微宮，改為朝獻，有司行事為薦獻。

translations.literal: From now on, whenever the emperor personally reports and presents to the Supreme Clarity and Supreme Subtlety palaces, this is changed to court presentation; when the offices perform the rite, it is presentation offering.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth personal presentation to Supreme Clarity and Supreme Subtlety palaces became court presentation; when offices acted, presentation offering.

sentences.zh: 親告享宗廟改為朝享，有司行事為薦享。

translations.literal: Personal reporting and offering at the ancestral temple is changed to court offering; when the offices act, presentation offering.
translations.idiomatic: Personal ancestral reporting became court offering; when offices acted, presentation offering.

sentences.zh: 親巡陵改為朝陵，有司行事為拜陵。

translations.literal: Personal inspection of the tombs is changed to court tomb visit; when the offices act, tomb obeisance.
translations.idiomatic: Personal tomb visits became court tomb visits; when offices acted, tomb obeisance.

sentences.zh: 應諸事告宗廟者，並改為表。

translations.literal: All matters that reported to the ancestral temple were likewise changed to memorial.
translations.idiomatic: All reports to the ancestral temple became memorials.

sentences.zh: 其郊天、後土及享祠祝文雲'敢昭告'者，並改為'敢昭薦'。

translations.literal: In suburban heaven, Queen Earth, and offering-sacrifice prayer texts that said "I dare brightly report," all were changed to "I dare brightly present."
translations.idiomatic: Suburban heaven, Queen Earth, and offering prayer texts saying "I dare brightly report" became "I dare brightly present."

sentences.zh: 」十載正月，有事于南郊，於壇所大赦。

translations.literal: " In the first month of year 10, the southern suburb ceremony was performed; at the altar site there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: " Year 10, first month: southern suburb rites; great amnesty at the altar.

sentences.zh: 制：「自今已後，攝祭南郊，薦獻太清宮，薦享太廟，其太尉行事前一日，於致齋所具羽儀鹵簿，公服引入，親授祝版，乃赴清齋所。

translations.literal: An ordinance stated: "From now on, when the regent sacrifices at the southern suburb, presents offerings at the Supreme Clarity Palace, and presents offerings at the Grand Temple, on the day before the Grand Marshal conducts the rite, at the abstinence lodge full feather regalia and insignia escort are prepared; in official dress he is led in, the prayer board is personally handed to him, and only then does he go to the pure abstinence lodge."
translations.idiomatic: Ordinance: henceforth when a regent sacrificed at the southern suburb, presented at Supreme Clarity Palace and Grand Temple, the Grand Marshal on the eve at the abstinence lodge received full regalia and escort in official dress, was handed the prayer board personally, then went to pure abstinence.
Closing quote of the ordinance.

sentences.zh: 汾陰後土之祀，自漢武帝後廢而不行。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to Queen Earth at Fenyin—after Emperor Wu of Han it was abolished and not performed.
translations.idiomatic: Fenyin Queen Earth sacrifice had been abandoned since Han Emperor Wu.

sentences.zh: 玄宗開元十年，將自東都北巡，幸太原，便還京，乃下制曰：「王者承事天地以為主，郊享泰尊以通神。

translations.literal: In Kaiyuan year 10 Xuanzong was about to tour north from the Eastern Capital, visit Taiyuan, and return to the capital, and issued an ordinance: "The king receives and serves Heaven and Earth as his masters; suburban offering to the greatest honored reaches the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 10: touring north from the Eastern Capital via Taiyuan, Xuanzong issued an ordinance: "The king serves Heaven and Earth as masters; suburban offering to the greatest honored reaches the spirits.

sentences.zh: 蓋燔柴泰壇，定天位也；

translations.literal: For burning firewood at the greatest altar fixes the position of Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Burning firewood at the greatest altar fixes Heaven's position;

sentences.zh: 瘞埋泰折，就陰位也。

translations.literal: burying in the greatest clearing takes the position of yin.
translations.idiomatic: burying in the greatest clearing takes yin's position.

sentences.zh: 將以昭報靈祇，克崇嚴配。

translations.literal: Thus to make bright return to the numinous powers and fully exalt solemn matching.
translations.idiomatic: Thus to repay the numinous and exalt solemn matching.

sentences.zh: 爰逮秦、漢，稽諸祀典，立甘泉於雍畤，定後土于汾陰，遺廟嶷然，靈光可燭。

translations.literal: Down to Qin and Han, consulting the sacrifice canon, Ganquan was established at Yongzhi and Queen Earth fixed at Fenyin; the surviving temples stand lofty, their spiritual light fit to illuminate.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin and Han, per the canon, Ganquan stood at Yongzhi and Queen Earth at Fenyin; surviving temples stand lofty, spiritual light illuminating.

sentences.zh: 朕觀風唐、晉，望秩山川，肅恭明神，因致禋敬，將欲為人求福，以輔升平。

translations.literal: I observe the customs of Tang and Jin, rank the mountains and rivers, reverently serve the bright spirits, and thereby perform the most reverent offering, wishing to seek blessing for the people and aid ascending peace.
translations.idiomatic: I have observed Tang and Jin customs, ranked mountains and rivers, reverently served bright spirits, and performed the deepest offering to seek the people's blessing and aid peace.

sentences.zh: 今此神符，應於嘉德。

translations.literal: Now this divine talisman responds to excellent virtue.
translations.idiomatic: This divine talisman now responds to excellent virtue.

sentences.zh: 行幸至汾陰，宜以來年二月十六日祠後土，所司准式。

translations.literal: When the imperial progress reaches Fenyin, on the sixteenth day of the second month of the coming year Queen Earth should be sacrificed to; the offices follow the regulations."
translations.idiomatic: At Fenyin, Queen Earth should be sacrificed on the coming year's second-month sixteenth day; the offices follow regulations."
Closing quote of the ordinance.

sentences.zh: 先是，脽上有後土祠，嘗為婦人塑像，則天時移河西梁山神塑像，就祠中配焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, on the mound there was a Queen Earth shrine; it had once held a woman's image; in Wu Zetian's time the image of the Liangshan spirit of Hexi was moved in to be matched in the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the mound had a Queen Earth shrine with a woman's image; under Wu Zetian Liangshan's image from Hexi was moved in as consort.

sentences.zh: 至是，有司送梁山神像於祠外之別室，內出錦繡衣服，以上後土之神，乃更加裝飾焉。

translations.literal: On this occasion the offices sent the Liangshan spirit image to a separate chamber outside the shrine; brocade and embroidered garments were issued from within to invest Queen Earth's spirit, and decoration was further added.
translations.idiomatic: The Liangshan image was moved to an outer chamber; palace brocades clothed Queen Earth's spirit and decoration was increased.

sentences.zh: 又於祠堂院外設壇，如皇地祇之制。

translations.literal: An altar was also set outside the shrine courtyard, like the regulations for August Earth Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: An altar was set outside the courtyard like August Earth Spirit's rite.

sentences.zh: 及所司起作，獲寶鼎三枚以獻，十一年二月，上親祠於壇上，亦如方丘儀。

translations.literal: When the offices undertook construction, three treasure cauldrons were obtained and presented; in the second month of year 11 the emperor personally sacrificed on the altar, likewise following the square-mound rite.
translations.idiomatic: During construction three treasure cauldrons were found; year 11, second month, the emperor sacrificed on the altar by square-mound rite.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，詔改汾陰為寶鼎。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, an edict changed Fenyin to Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: After the rites, Fenyin was renamed Baoding.

sentences.zh: 亞獻邠王守禮、終獻甯王憲已，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: Secondary presenter Prince Shouli of Bin and final presenter Prince Xian of Ning having finished, distributions of gifts differed in degree.
translations.idiomatic: After secondary presenter Prince Shouli of Bin and final presenter Prince Xian of Ning, gifts differed by rank.

sentences.zh: 二十年，車駕又從東都幸太原，還京。

translations.literal: In year 20 the imperial carriage again went from the Eastern Capital to Taiyuan and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Year 20: the court again went from the Eastern Capital to Taiyuan and back.

sentences.zh: 中書令蕭嵩上言：「去十一年親祠後土，為祈穀，自是神明昭格，累年豐登。

translations.literal: Chief Councilor Xiao Song submitted: "Eleven years ago Your Majesty personally sacrificed to Queen Earth to pray for grain; since then the spirits have been manifest and years have piled up in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councilor Xiao Song said: "Eleven years ago you sacrificed to Queen Earth for grain; spirits answered and harvests have been abundant.

sentences.zh: 有祈必報，禮之大者。

translations.literal: When there is prayer there must be response—this is the greatest of rites.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer demands response—the greatest of rites.

sentences.zh: 且漢武親祠脽上，前後數四，伏請准舊祀後土，行賽之禮。

translations.literal: Moreover Han Wu personally sacrificed on the mound four times in succession; I humbly request following the old sacrifice to Queen Earth and performing the thanksgiving rite."
translations.idiomatic: Han Wu sacrificed on the mound four times; I beg to follow the old Queen Earth rite with thanksgiving."

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 其年十一月至寶鼎，又親祠以申賽謝。

translations.literal: That year, in the eleventh month, reaching Baoding, he again personally sacrificed to declare the thanksgiving.
translations.idiomatic: That eleventh month at Baoding he sacrificed again in thanksgiving.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，大赦。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: After the rites came a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 仍令所司刊石祠所，上自為其文。

translations.literal: The offices were still ordered to carve stone at the shrine site; the emperor himself composed the text.
translations.idiomatic: The offices were ordered to carve stone at the shrine; the emperor wrote the text.

sentences.zh: 開元二十四年七月乙巳，初置壽星壇，祭老人星及角、亢等七宿。

translations.literal: On yisi of the seventh month of Kaiyuan year 24, the Longevity Star altar was first established, sacrificing to the Old Man star and the seven lodges Horn, Neck, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 24, seventh month, yisi: the Longevity Star altar was first set to sacrifice to the Old Man star and the seven lodges Horn, Neck, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 天寶三年，有術士蘇嘉慶上言：「請於京東朝日壇東，置九宮貴神壇，其壇三成，成三尺，四階。

translations.literal: In Tianbao year 3, the technician Su Jiaqing submitted: "I request east of the Morning Sun altar in the eastern capital, establishing an altar to the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits; the altar has three tiers, each tier three chi, with four steps."
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 3: technician Su Jiaqing asked to set an altar to the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits east of the eastern capital's Morning Sun altar, three tiers of three chi each with four steps.

sentences.zh: 其上依位置九壇，壇尺五寸，東南曰招搖，正東曰軒轅，東北曰太陰，正南曰天一，中央曰天符，正北曰太一，西南曰攝提，正西曰咸池，西北曰青龍。

translations.literal: Above, nine altars were placed by position, each altar one chi five inches: southeast called Alluring; due east, Chariot Axis; northeast, Great Yin; due south, Heaven One; center, Heaven Talisman; due north, Great One; southwest, Grasping the Handle; due west, Salt Pool; northwest, Azure Dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Above, nine one-chi-five-inch altars by position: southeast Alluring; east Chariot Axis; northeast Great Yin; south Heaven One; center Heaven Talisman; north Great One; southwest Grasping the Handle; west Salt Pool; northwest Azure Dragon.

sentences.zh: 五為中，戴九履一，左三右七，二四為上，六八為下，符於遁甲。

translations.literal: Five is the center; wearing nine and treading one; three on the left and seven on the right; two and four above, six and eight below—matching the Dunjia.
translations.idiomatic: Five at center; wearing nine, treading one; three left, seven right; two and four above, six and eight below—per Dunjia.

sentences.zh: 四孟月祭，尊為九宮貴神，禮次昊天上帝，而在太清宮太廟上。

translations.literal: Sacrificed in the four first months of the seasons, honored as the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits; the rite ranks below August Heaven High God but above the Supreme Clarity Palace and Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificed in the four seasonal first months as Nine Palaces Noble Spirits; rite ranked below August Heaven High God but above Supreme Clarity Palace and Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 用牲牢、璧幣，類於天地神祇。

translations.literal: Oxen and sheep, jade disks and silks were used, like the spirits of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Oxen, jade disks, and silks were used, as for Heaven and Earth spirits.

sentences.zh: 」玄宗親祀之。

translations.literal: " Xuanzong personally sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuanzong sacrificed in person.

sentences.zh: 如有司行事，即宰相為之。

translations.literal: If the offices performed the rite, the chief councilor did so.
translations.idiomatic: When offices performed it, the chief councilor did.

sentences.zh: 肅宗乾元三年正月，又親祀之。

translations.literal: In the first month of Qianyuan year 3 under Suzong, he again personally sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: Qianyuan 3, first month: Suzong sacrificed again in person.

sentences.zh: 初，九宮神位，四時改位，呼為飛位。

translations.literal: Initially the Nine Palaces spirit seats shifted position each season, called flying position.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Nine Palaces seats shifted each season—the "flying position."

sentences.zh: 乾元之後，不易位。

translations.literal: After Qianyuan they no longer shifted position.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianyuan they no longer shifted.

sentences.zh: 大和二年八月，監察御史舒元輿奏：「七月十八日，祀九宮貴神，臣次合監祭，職當檢察禮物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Dahe year 2, Supervising Censor Shu Yuanyu memorialized: "On the eighteenth day of the seventh month the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits were sacrificed to; I was next to oversee the sacrifice and duty-bound to inspect the ritual goods.
translations.idiomatic: Dahe 2, eighth month: Supervising Censor Shu Yuanyu said that on the seventh month's eighteenth he was to oversee the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits sacrifice and inspect ritual goods.

sentences.zh: 伏見祝版九片，臣伏讀既竟，竊見陛下親署禦名及稱臣於九宮之神。

translations.literal: I observed nine prayer boards; having finished reading them on my knees, I privately saw that Your Majesty had personally signed his sacred name and styled himself subject to the Nine Palaces spirits.
translations.idiomatic: He saw nine prayer boards; reading them, he found the emperor had signed his name and styled himself subject to the Nine Palaces spirits.

sentences.zh: 臣伏以天子之尊，除祭天地、宗廟之外，無合稱臣者。

translations.literal: I submit that in the Son of Heaven's exalted station, apart from sacrificing to Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temple, there is none who should be styled subject.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temple, the Son of Heaven should style no one as subject.

sentences.zh: 王者父天母地，兄日姊月，此以九宮為目，是宜分方而守其位。

translations.literal: The king fathers Heaven and mothers Earth; the sun is elder brother and the moon elder sister; taking the Nine Palaces as kin, they ought each to keep their position by direction.
translations.idiomatic: The king fathers Heaven and mothers Earth; sun and moon are elder siblings; the Nine Palaces should each keep their directional place.

sentences.zh: 臣又觀其名號，乃太一、天一、招搖、軒轅、咸池、青龍、太陰、天符、攝提也。

translations.literal: I further observed their names and titles: Great One, Heaven One, Alluring, Chariot Axis, Salt Pool, Azure Dragon, Great Yin, Heaven Talisman, and Grasping the Handle.
translations.idiomatic: Their names were Great One, Heaven One, Alluring, Chariot Axis, Salt Pool, Azure Dragon, Great Yin, Heaven Talisman, and Grasping the Handle.

sentences.zh: 此九神，於天地猶子男也，于日月猶侯伯也。

translations.literal: These nine spirits, toward Heaven and Earth, are like sons and younger men; toward sun and moon, like marquises and earls.
translations.idiomatic: These nine spirits toward Heaven and Earth are like sons and cadets; toward sun and moon, like marquises and earls.

sentences.zh: 陛下尊為天子，豈可反臣於天之子男耶？

translations.literal: Your Majesty, exalted as Son of Heaven—how can you in turn be subject to Heaven's sons and younger men?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is Son of Heaven—how become subject to Heaven's sons and cadets?

sentences.zh: 臣竊以為過。

translations.literal: I privately deem this a fault.
translations.idiomatic: I deem this a fault.

sentences.zh: 縱陰陽者流言其合祀，則陛下當合稱皇帝遣某官致祭於九宮之神，不宜稱臣與名。

translations.literal: Even if yin-yang masters spread word of joint sacrifice, Your Majesty should jointly style himself emperor and dispatch a certain official to present sacrifice to the Nine Palaces spirits; he should not style himself subject or sign his name.
translations.idiomatic: Even if yin-yang masters urged joint sacrifice, the emperor should say "the emperor dispatches an official to sacrifice to the Nine Palaces spirits," not style himself subject or sign his name.

sentences.zh: 臣實愚瞽，不知其可。

translations.literal: I am truly dull and blind and do not know whether it is permissible.
translations.idiomatic: I am dull and do not know whether it is permissible.

sentences.zh: 伏緣行事在明日雞初鳴時，成命已行，臣不敢滯。

translations.literal: Because the rite falls at cock-crow tomorrow and the completed order has already been issued, I dare not delay.
translations.idiomatic: As the rite is at tomorrow's cock-crow and orders are issued, I dare not delay.

sentences.zh: 伏乞聖慈異日降明詔禮官詳議，冀嘉萬乘之尊，無所虧降，悠久誤典，因此可正。

translations.literal: I humbly beg sagely compassion on another day to issue a clear edict for ritual officers to deliberate in detail, hoping to honor the exalted station of the ten-thousand-chariot lord without impairment, and that long-standing mistaken canon may thereby be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that another day an edict order ritual officers to deliberate, honoring the ten-thousand-chariot lord without impairment and correcting long-standing error.

sentences.zh: 」詔都省議，皆如元輿之議。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to deliberate; all followed Yuanyu's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " The Department of State Affairs deliberated; all followed Yuanyu.

sentences.zh: 乃降為中祠，祝版稱皇帝，不署。

translations.literal: It was then demoted to middle sacrifice; prayer boards styled emperor without signature.
translations.idiomatic: The rite was demoted to middle sacrifice; prayer boards said "emperor" without signature.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年十二月，中書門下奏：「准天寶三載十月六日敕，'九宮貴神，實司水旱，功佐上帝，德庇下人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Huichang year 1, the Secretariat memorialized: "Per the Tianbao year 3, tenth month, sixth day edict, 'The Nine Palaces Noble Spirits truly govern flood and drought, their merit assisting High God, their virtue sheltering those below.
translations.idiomatic: Huichang 1, twelfth month: Secretariat cited Tianbao 3, tenth month, day 6: "Nine Palaces Noble Spirits govern flood and drought, assist High God, shelter the people.

sentences.zh: 冀喜穀歲登，災害不作。

translations.literal: May the grain year be glad and disasters not arise.
translations.idiomatic: May grain years be glad and disasters cease.

sentences.zh: 每至四時初節，令中書門下往攝祭'者。

translations.literal: At each of the four seasons' opening nodes, let the Secretariat and Chancellery go to perform the regent sacrifice'—"
translations.idiomatic: At each seasonal opening node, let Secretariat and Chancellery perform regent sacrifice"—

sentences.zh: 准禮，九宮次昊天上帝，壇在太清宮、太廟上，用牲牢、璧幣，類於天地。

translations.literal: per ritual, the Nine Palaces rank below August Heaven High God; the altar stands above the Supreme Clarity Palace and Grand Temple; oxen and jade disks and silks are used, like Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: by ritual Nine Palaces rank below August Heaven High God, altar above Supreme Clarity and Grand Temple, with oxen, disks, and silks like Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 天寶三載十二月，玄宗親祠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Tianbao year 3, Xuanzong personally sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 3, twelfth month: Xuanzong sacrificed in person.

sentences.zh: 乾元二年正月，肅宗親祀。

translations.literal: In the first month of Qianyuan year 2, Suzong personally sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: Qianyuan 2, first month: Suzong sacrificed in person.

sentences.zh: 伏自累年已來，水旱愆候，恐是有司禱請，誠敬稍虧。

translations.literal: I submit that in successive years flood and drought have been untimely; I fear the offices' prayers have slackened in sincerity and reverence.
translations.idiomatic: For years flood and drought have been untimely; offices' prayers may have slackened in sincerity.

sentences.zh: 今屬孟春，合修祀典，望至明年正月祭日，差宰臣一人禱請。

translations.literal: Now it is early spring and the sacrifice canon should be restored; I hope that by next year's first-month sacrifice day one chief minister may be sent to pray.
translations.idiomatic: Now in early spring the canon should be restored; I hope one chief minister will pray by next year's first-month sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 向後四時祭，並請差僕射、少師、少保、尚書、太常卿等官，所冀稍重其事，以申嚴敬。

translations.literal: For the four seasonal sacrifices hereafter, please dispatch vice directors, junior mentors, junior guardians, ministers, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and the like, hoping thereby slightly to weight the affair and declare solemn reverence.
