translations.idiomatic: Hereafter let vice directors, junior mentors, guardians, ministers, and the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness conduct the four seasonal sacrifices to weight the rite and show reverence.

sentences.zh: 臣等十一月二十五日已于延英面奏，伏奉聖旨令檢儀注進來者。

translations.literal: We on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month already reported face to face in Yanying; we received the sacred command to have the ritual regulations examined and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: We reported in Yanying on the eleventh month's twenty-fifth and received orders to submit ritual regulations.

sentences.zh: 今欲祭時，伏望令有司崇飾舊壇，務于嚴潔。

translations.literal: For the coming sacrifice, I hope the offices may be ordered to adorn the old altar with emphasis on solemn purity."
translations.idiomatic: For the coming sacrifice, I hope the offices will adorn the old altar with solemn purity."

sentences.zh: 」敕旨依奏。

translations.literal: " The edict followed the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 二年正月四日，太常禮院奏：「准監察御史關牒：'今月十三日，祀九宮貴神，已敕宰相崔珙攝太尉行事，合受誓誡，及有司徒、司空否？

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the first month of year 2, the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office memorialized: "Per the Supervising Censor's dispatch: 'On the thirteenth of this month the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits will be sacrificed to; the chief councilor Cui Gong has already been ordered to act as regent Grand Marshal—should he receive the oath and abstinence, and are there Minister of Education and Minister of Works?'"
translations.idiomatic: Year 2, first month, day 4: Imperial Clan Ritual Office cited a censor's dispatch: on the thirteenth Cui Gong would regent as Grand Marshal for the Nine Palaces—should he take oath and abstinence, and were Minister of Education and Works required?

sentences.zh: '伏以前件祭本稱大祠，准大和三年七月二十四日敕，降為中祠。

translations.literal: ' I submit that the former sacrifice was originally called great sacrifice; per the Dahe year 3, seventh month, twenty-fourth day edict, it was demoted to middle sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The former rite was great sacrifice; per Dahe 3, seventh month, day 24, it was demoted to middle sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 昨據敕文，只稱崇飾舊壇，務于嚴潔，不令別進儀注，更有改移。

translations.literal: Yesterday's edict text spoke only of adorning the old altar with emphasis on solemn purity, not of separately submitting ritual regulations or further changes.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday's edict spoke only of adorning the old altar, not of new regulations or changes.

sentences.zh: 伏恐不合卻用大祠禮料，伏候裁旨。

translations.literal: I fear it may not be fitting to revert to great-sacrifice ritual goods; I await the decisive edict."
translations.idiomatic: I fear reverting to great-sacrifice goods; I await decision."

sentences.zh: 」中書門下奏曰：

translations.literal: " The Secretariat memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: " The Secretariat replied:

sentences.zh: 臣准天寶三載十月六日敕，「九宮貴神，實司水旱。

translations.literal: Your servant follows the Tianbao year 3, tenth month, sixth day edict: "The Nine Palaces Noble Spirits truly govern flood and drought."
translations.idiomatic: Per Tianbao 3, tenth month, day 6: "Nine Palaces Noble Spirits truly govern flood and drought."

sentences.zh: 」臣等伏睹，既經兩朝親祠，必是祈請有征，況自大和已來，水旱愆候，陛下常憂稼穡，每念烝黎。

translations.literal: Your servants observe that since two reigns have personally sacrificed, prayers must have had response; moreover since Dahe, flood and drought have been untimely; Your Majesty constantly worries over the crops and thinks of the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: Two reigns sacrificed in person, so prayers answered; since Dahe, flood and drought have troubled you and the people.

sentences.zh: 臣等合副聖心，以修墜典。

translations.literal: Your servants ought to accord with the sacred mind and restore the fallen canon.
translations.idiomatic: We ought to accord with your mind and restore the fallen canon.

sentences.zh: 伏見大和三年禮官狀云：「縱司水旱兵荒，品秩不過列宿。

translations.literal: I observe the Dahe year 3 ritual officers' report: "Even if they govern flood, drought, and war famine, rank does not exceed the lunar mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Dahe 3 ritual officers said: "Even governing flood, drought, and war famine, rank does not exceed lunar mansions.

sentences.zh: 今者五星悉是從祀，日月猶在中祀。

translations.literal: Now the Five Stars are all attendant sacrifices; sun and moon remain middle sacrifices."
translations.idiomatic: Now the Five Stars are attendant sacrifices; sun and moon remain middle sacrifices."

sentences.zh: 」竊詳其意，以星辰不合比於天官。

translations.literal: I examined their intent in detail: they held that stars should not be compared to celestial offices.
translations.idiomatic: They held stars should not be compared to celestial offices.

sentences.zh: 曾不知統而言之，則為天地，在於辰象，自有尊卑。

translations.literal: They did not know that speaking comprehensively, they are Heaven and Earth; among the asterisms there is naturally high and low.
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensively they are Heaven and Earth; among asterisms there is naturally high and low.

sentences.zh: 謹按後魏王鈞《志》：「北辰第二星，盛而常明者乃為元星露寢，天帝常居，始由道奧而為變通之跡。

translations.literal: I respectfully consult the Annals of Northern Wei Wang Jun: "The second star of the North Pole, when bright and always luminous, is the primal star's exposed couch; the High God constantly dwells there, beginning from the mystery of the Way and becoming the traces of change and transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun's Northern Wei Annals: "The North Pole's second star, bright and always luminous, is the primal star's exposed couch where the High God dwells, from the Way's mystery into change."

sentences.zh: 又天皇大帝，其精曜魄寶，蓋萬神之秘圖，河海之命紀皆稟焉。

translations.literal: Also the Great Emperor of Heaven, his essence the Radiant Jewel of the Soul—covering the secret chart of the myriad spirits; the mandates and records of rivers and seas all receive from him."
translations.idiomatic: Also the Great Emperor of Heaven, essence the Radiant Soul Jewel, secret chart of myriad spirits; rivers and seas receive mandate from him."

sentences.zh: 」據茲說即昊天上帝也。

translations.literal: " According to this doctrine, that is August Heaven High God.
translations.idiomatic: " By this doctrine that is August Heaven High God.

sentences.zh: 天一掌八氣、九精之政令，以佐天極。

translations.literal: Heaven One governs the eight qi and nine essences' commands to assist the celestial pole.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven One governs the eight qi and nine essences to assist the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 征明而有常，則陰陽序，大運興。

translations.literal: When its manifestation is bright and constant, yin and yang are ordered and the great cycle rises.
translations.idiomatic: When its manifestation is bright and constant, yin and yang order themselves and the great cycle rises.

sentences.zh: 太一掌十有六神之法度，以輔人極。

translations.literal: Great One governs the law and measure of the sixteen spirits of the ten to assist the human pole.
translations.idiomatic: Great One governs the sixteen spirits' law to assist the human pole.

sentences.zh: 征明面得中，，則神人和而王道升平。

translations.literal: When its manifestation is bright and centered, then spirits and men harmonize and the kingly way ascends in peace.
translations.idiomatic: When its manifestation is bright and centered, spirits and men harmonize and the kingly way ascends in peace.

sentences.zh: 又北斗有權、衡二星，天一、太一參居其間，所以財成天地，輔相神道也。

translations.literal: Also in the Northern Dipper are the Balance stars Authority and Weight; Heaven One and Great One participate between them—thereby completing Heaven and Earth and assisting the spirit way.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dipper, Authority and Weight stars stand with Heaven One and Great One between them, completing Heaven and Earth and assisting the spirit way.

sentences.zh: 若一概以列宿論之，實為淺近。

translations.literal: If one uniformly discusses them as lunar mansions, it is truly shallow and near.
translations.idiomatic: To treat them uniformly as lunar mansions is shallow.

sentences.zh: 按《漢書》曰：「天神貴者太一，佐曰五帝。

translations.literal: According to the Book of Han: "Among heavenly spirits the honored is Great One; assistants are called the Five Emperors."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Han: "Among heavenly spirits the honored is Great One; assistants are the Five Emperors."

sentences.zh: 」古者天子以春秋祭太一，列於祀典，其來久矣。

translations.literal: " In antiquity the Son of Heaven in spring and autumn sacrificed to Great One; it is listed in the sacrifice canon—its origin is long.
translations.idiomatic: " Antiquity's Son of Heaven sacrificed to Great One in spring and autumn; long listed in the canon.

sentences.zh: 今五帝猶為大祀，則太一無宜降祀，稍重其祀，固為得所。

translations.literal: Now the Five Emperors are still great sacrifice; then Great One should not be demoted in sacrifice; slightly to weight its sacrifice is indeed fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Emperors remain great sacrifice; Great One should not be demoted; weighting its sacrifice is fitting.

sentences.zh: 劉向有言曰：「祖宗所立神祇舊典，誠未易動。

translations.literal: Liu Xiang said: "The old canon of spirits established by the ancestors is truly not easy to move."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiang: "Ancestors' spirit canon is not easy to move."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「古今異制，經無明文，至尊至重，難以疑說正也。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Ancient and modern differ in institution; the classics have no explicit text; the most honored is most weighty—hard to correct by doubtful discourse."
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "Institutions differ; classics lack explicit text; the most honored is hard to correct by doubtful discourse."

sentences.zh: 」其意不欲非祖宗舊典。

translations.literal: " His intent was not to fault the ancestors' old canon.
translations.idiomatic: " He did not wish to fault the ancestors' canon.

sentences.zh: 以劉向之博通，尚難於改作，況臣等學不究於天人，識尤懵於祀典，欲為參酌，恐未得中。

translations.literal: With Liu Xiang's broad mastery, change was still difficult; how much more for your servants, whose learning does not reach to Heaven and man and whose knowledge is especially blind in sacrifice canon—wishing to deliberate in the middle, I fear we may not hit it.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiang, though learned, found change hard; we are less versed in Heaven, man, and sacrifice—deliberation may miss the mark.

sentences.zh: 伏望更令太常卿與學官同詳定，庶獲明據。

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will further order the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness together with academic officers to fix it in detail, that we may obtain clear evidence.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and academic officers fix it in detail for clear evidence.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 檢校左僕射太常卿王起、廣文博士盧就等獻議曰：

translations.literal: Acting Left Vice Director and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Qi, Guangwen Erudite Lu Jiu, and others presented deliberation:
translations.idiomatic: Acting Left Vice Director Wang Qi, Guangwen Erudite Lu Jiu, and others deliberated:

sentences.zh: 伏以九宮貴神，位列星座；

translations.literal: I submit that the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits occupy positions among the constellations;
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Palaces Noble Spirits occupy constellation positions;

sentences.zh: 往因致福，詔立祠壇。

translations.literal: formerly, because blessing was obtained, an edict established the altar.
translations.idiomatic: blessing once obtained, an edict established the altar.

sentences.zh: 降至尊以稱臣，就東郊以親拜。

translations.literal: the most honored styled himself subject and went to the eastern suburb to bow in person.
translations.idiomatic: the most honored styled himself subject and bowed at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 在祀典雖雲過禮，庇群生豈患無文，思福黔黎，特申嚴奉，誠聖人屈已以安天下之心也。

translations.literal: In the sacrifice canon it was said to exceed ritual, yet sheltering the myriad lives—would one worry over lack of text? Thinking to bless the black-haired people, he specially declared solemn service—truly the sage bent himself to settle the mind of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The canon called it excessive, yet to shelter all lives—why lack text? To bless the people he declared solemn service—the sage bent himself to settle the realm.

sentences.zh: 厥後祝史不明，精誠亦怠，禮官建議，降處中祠。

translations.literal: Afterward the prayer officers were unclear and sincerity also slackened; ritual officers proposed demotion to middle sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Later prayer officers grew unclear and sincerity slackened; ritual officers proposed middle sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今聖德憂勤，期臻壽域，兵荒水旱，寤寐軫懷，爰命台臣，緝興墜典。

translations.literal: Now sagely virtue is anxious and diligent, expecting to reach the realm of longevity; war, famine, flood, and drought fill waking and sleeping with care; therefore terrace ministers were ordered to gather and revive the fallen canon.
translations.idiomatic: Now sagely virtue is diligent, longing for longevity; war, famine, flood, and drought fill your care; terrace ministers were ordered to revive the fallen canon.

sentences.zh: 伏惟九宮所稱之神，即太一、攝提、軒轅、招搖、天符、青龍、咸池、太陰、天一者也。

translations.literal: I respectfully consider the spirits called by the Nine Palaces: they are Great One, Grasping the Handle, Chariot Axis, Alluring, Heaven Talisman, Azure Dragon, Salt Pool, Great Yin, and Heaven One.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Palaces spirits are Great One, Grasping the Handle, Chariot Axis, Alluring, Heaven Talisman, Azure Dragon, Salt Pool, Great Yin, and Heaven One.

sentences.zh: 謹按《黃帝九宮經》及蕭吉《五行大義》：「一宮，其神太一，其星天蓬，其卦坎，其行水，其方白。

translations.literal: I respectfully consult the Yellow Emperor's Classic of the Nine Palaces and Xiao Ji's Great Meaning of the Five Phases: "First palace—its spirit Great One, its star Celestial Rampart, its hexagram Kan, its phase water, its direction white.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Emperor's Nine Palaces and Xiao Ji's Five Phases: "First palace—spirit Great One, star Celestial Rampart, hexagram Kan, phase water, direction white.

sentences.zh: 二宮，其神攝提，其星天芮，其卦坤，其行土，其方黑。

translations.literal: Second palace—its spirit Grasping the Handle, its star Celestial Core, its hexagram Kun, its phase earth, its direction black.
translations.idiomatic: Second palace—spirit Grasping the Handle, star Celestial Core, hexagram Kun, phase earth, direction black.

sentences.zh: 三宮，其神軒轅，其星天沖，其卦震，其行木，其方碧。

translations.literal: Third palace—its spirit Chariot Axis, its star Celestial Assault, its hexagram Zhen, its phase wood, its direction blue-green.
translations.idiomatic: Third palace—spirit Chariot Axis, star Celestial Assault, hexagram Zhen, phase wood, direction blue-green.

sentences.zh: 四宮，其神招搖，其星天輔，其卦巽，其行木，其方綠。

translations.literal: Fourth palace—its spirit Alluring, its star Celestial Assistant, its hexagram Xun, its phase wood, its direction green.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth palace—spirit Alluring, star Celestial Assistant, hexagram Xun, phase wood, direction green.

sentences.zh: 五宮，其神天符，其星天禽，其卦離，其行土，其方黃。

translations.literal: Fifth palace—its spirit Heaven Talisman, its star Celestial Poultry, its hexagram Li, its phase earth, its direction yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth palace—spirit Heaven Talisman, star Celestial Poultry, hexagram Li, phase earth, direction yellow.

sentences.zh: 六宮，其神青龍，其星天心，其卦乾，其行金，其方白。

translations.literal: Sixth palace—its spirit Azure Dragon, its star Celestial Heart, its hexagram Qian, its phase metal, its direction white.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth palace—spirit Azure Dragon, star Celestial Heart, hexagram Qian, phase metal, direction white.

sentences.zh: 七宮，其神咸池，其星天柱，其卦兌，其行金，其方赤。

translations.literal: Seventh palace—its spirit Salt Pool, its star Celestial Pillar, its hexagram Dui, its phase metal, its direction red.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh palace—spirit Salt Pool, star Celestial Pillar, hexagram Dui, phase metal, direction red.

sentences.zh: 八宮，其神太陰，其星天任，其卦艮，其行土，其方白。

translations.literal: Eighth palace—its spirit Great Yin, its star Celestial Assignment, its hexagram Gen, its phase earth, its direction white.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth palace—spirit Great Yin, star Celestial Assignment, hexagram Gen, phase earth, direction white.

sentences.zh: 九宮，其神天一，其星天英，其卦離，其行火，其方紫。

translations.literal: Ninth palace—its spirit Heaven One, its star Celestial Hero, its hexagram Li, its phase fire, its direction purple."
translations.idiomatic: Ninth palace—spirit Heaven One, star Celestial Hero, hexagram Li, phase fire, direction purple."

sentences.zh: 」觀其統八卦，運五行，土飛於中，數轉於極，雖敬事迎厘，不聞經見，而範圍亭育，有助昌時，以此兩朝親祀而臻百祥也。

translations.literal: " Observing that they comprehend the Eight Trigrams and operate the Five Phases, earth flies in the center and numbers turn at the pole—though reverent service to welcome blessing is not heard in the classics, yet encompassing and nurturing has helped flourishing times; on this account the two reigns' personal sacrifice attained the hundred auspices.
translations.idiomatic: " They comprehend the Eight Trigrams and operate the Five Phases; earth flies at center and numbers turn at the pole—though classics do not record reverent welcome of blessing, their encompassing nurture helped flourishing times; two reigns' personal sacrifice attained hundred auspices.

sentences.zh: 然以萬物之精，上為列星，星之運行，必系於物。

translations.literal: Yet the essence of the myriad things ascends as ordered stars; the stars' motion must depend on things.
translations.idiomatic: Yet myriad essences ascend as stars; stars' motion depends on things.

sentences.zh: 貴而居者，則必統八氣，總萬神，斡權化於混茫，賦品匯于陰騭，與天地日月，誠相參也。

translations.literal: Those noble in station must govern the eight qi and total the myriad spirits, turning authority and transformation in the vast dark and assigning categories in yin influence—truly participating with Heaven, Earth, sun, and moon.
translations.idiomatic: The noble govern eight qi and myriad spirits, turning authority in the vast dark and assigning categories in yin influence—truly with Heaven, Earth, sun, and moon.

sentences.zh: 豈得醫賴於敷祐，而屈降於等夷？

translations.literal: How can one still rely on their spreading blessings yet demote them to equal rank?
translations.idiomatic: How can one rely on their blessings yet demote them to equal rank?

sentences.zh: 又據太尉攝祀九宮貴神舊儀：前七日，受誓誡於尚書省，散齋四日，致齋三日。

translations.literal: Also according to the old rite for the regent Grand Marshal's sacrifice to the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits: seven days before, oath and abstinence are received at the Department of State Affairs; dispersed abstinence four days, concentrated abstinence three days.
translations.idiomatic: Per the regent Grand Marshal's old Nine Palaces rite: seven days before, oath and abstinence at State Affairs; four days dispersed abstinence, three concentrated.

sentences.zh: 牲用犢。

translations.literal: Victims use calves.
translations.idiomatic: Victims were calves.

sentences.zh: 祝版禦署，稱嗣天子臣。

translations.literal: Prayer boards bore the imperial signature, styling heir Son of Heaven subject.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer boards bore the imperial signature: "heir Son of Heaven subject."

sentences.zh: 圭幣樂成。

translations.literal: Jade disks, silks, and music completed.
translations.idiomatic: Jade disks, silks, and music completed the rite.

sentences.zh: 比類中祠，則無等級。

translations.literal: Compared to middle sacrifice, there was no gradation.
translations.idiomatic: Unlike middle sacrifice, it lacked gradation.

sentences.zh: 今據《江都集禮》及《開元禮》：蠟祭之日，大明、夜明二座及朝日、夕月，皇帝致祝，皆率稱臣。

translations.literal: Now according to the Collected Rites of Jiangdu and the Kaiyuan Rites: on the wax-sacrifice day, the two seats Great Brightness and Night Brightness and Morning Sun and Evening Moon—the emperor presenting prayer all styled himself subject.
translations.idiomatic: The Collected Rites of Jiangdu and Kaiyuan Rites: on wax day, Great Brightness, Night Brightness, Morning Sun, and Evening Moon—all prayer styled the emperor subject.

sentences.zh: 若以為非泰壇配祀之時，得主日報天之義。

translations.literal: If one holds that it is not the time of matching sacrifice at the greatest altar, one obtains the meaning of reporting to Heaven on the main day.
translations.idiomatic: If not the greatest altar's matching sacrifice, it still holds the meaning of reporting to Heaven on the main day.

sentences.zh: 卑緣厭屈，尊用德伸，不以著在中祠，取類常祀。

translations.literal: The low by nature bends; the honored extend through virtue—not to be listed as middle sacrifice or taken as ordinary sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The low bend by nature; the honored extend through virtue—not middle sacrifice or ordinary sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 此則中祠用大祠之義也。

translations.literal: This is the meaning of middle sacrifice using great-sacrifice rites.
translations.idiomatic: This is middle sacrifice using great-sacrifice rites.

sentences.zh: 又據太社、太稷，開元之制，列在中祠。

translations.literal: Also according to the Grand Altars of Soil and Grain—in Kaiyuan's institution they were listed as middle sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Altars of Soil and Grain were middle sacrifice under Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 天寶三載二月十四日敕，改為大祠，自後因循，復用前禮。

translations.literal: On the Tianbao year 3, second month, fourteenth day edict, they were changed to great sacrifice; afterward by inertia the former rite was again used.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 3, second month, day 14 made them great sacrifice; afterward the former rite returned by inertia.

sentences.zh: 長慶三年正月，禮官獻議，始准前敕，稱為大祠。

translations.literal: In the first month of Changqing year 3, ritual officers presented deliberation and first followed the former edict, calling them great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing 3, first month: ritual officers followed the former edict and called them great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 唯禦署祝文，稱天子謹遣某官昭告。

translations.literal: Only the imperially signed prayer text styled "Son of Heaven respectfully dispatches a certain official to brightly report."
translations.idiomatic: Only the signed prayer said "Son of Heaven respectfully dispatches an official to brightly report."

sentences.zh: 文義以為殖物粒人，則宜增秩，致祝稱禱，有異方丘，不以伸為大祠，遂屈尊稱。

translations.literal: In textual meaning, because they propagate things and grain the people, rank ought to be increased; presenting prayer and styling prayer differ from the square mound—not to extend as great sacrifice, and so the honored title was bent.
translations.idiomatic: As they propagate things and grain the people, rank should rise; prayer differs from the square mound—not extending as great sacrifice, so the honored title was bent.

sentences.zh: 此又大祠用中祠之禮也。

translations.literal: This again is a great sacrifice using the rites of a middling sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Here again is the case of a great rite performed with middling-rite procedures.

sentences.zh: 參之日月既如彼，考之社稷又如此，所謂功钜者因之以殊禮，位稱者不敢易其文，是前聖後儒陟降之明征也。

translations.literal: Compare the sun and moon as above; examine the altars of soil and grain as below—what is called vast merit therefore receives special rites; what is called fitting rank dares not alter its text. This is the clear proof by which former sages and later scholars measured ascent and descent.
translations.idiomatic: Weigh the sun and moon as above, the altars of soil and grain as below: where merit is vast, special rites follow; where rank is fitting, none dare alter the wording. So sages past and scholars after have measured what may rise and what must fall.

sentences.zh: 今九宮貴神，既司水旱，降福禳災，人將賴之，追舉舊章，誠為得禮。

translations.literal: Now the Nine Palaces august spirits already govern flood and drought, bestow blessing and ward off disaster; the people will rely on them. To revive the old statutes is truly obtaining ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Palaces august spirits already govern flood and drought, bestow blessing and turn aside calamity—the people will lean on them. To revive the old statutes is truly proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 然以立祠非古，宅位有方，分職既異其司存，致祝必參乎等列。

translations.literal: Yet because establishing shrines is not ancient, dwelling positions have their directions, and divided duties already differ in their offices, invocations must participate in the gradations.
translations.idiomatic: Yet to establish shrines is not ancient custom; each seat has its direction, each office its charge—sacrificial invocations must be ranked accordingly.

sentences.zh: 求之折中，宜有變通，稍重之儀，有以為比。

translations.literal: Seeking the mean, there ought to be adaptation; a slightly heavier rite has something to compare with.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking the mean calls for adaptation—a rite slightly elevated, yet still comparable.

sentences.zh: 伏請自今已後，卻用大祠之禮，誓官備物，無有降差。

translations.literal: Humbly petition: from now on afterward, revert to using great-sacrifice rites; oath officers and prepared objects, without any reduction.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly petition that hereafter the great-sacrifice rites be restored in full—oath officers, offerings, and equipage, with no reduction whatsoever.

sentences.zh: 唯禦署祝文，以社稷為本，伏緣已稱臣於天帝，無二尊故也。

translations.literal: Only the Imperial Registry prayer text takes the altars of soil and grain as basis, humbly because one has already styled oneself subject before the Supreme Thearch—there cannot be two sovereigns.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Imperial Registry prayer text should take the altars of soil and grain as its basis—for the Son of Heaven has already styled himself subject before the Supreme God, and there cannot be two sovereigns.

sentences.zh: 敕旨依之，付所司。

translations.literal: The edict assented and was referred to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented and referred the matter to the proper offices.

sentences.zh: 天寶十載四月二十九日，移黃帝壇於子城內坤地，將親祠祭，壇成而止。

translations.literal: Tianbao tenth year, fourth month, twenty-ninth day: moved the Yellow Thearch altar to the kun quadrant within the inner city; about to sacrifice in person—the work stopped when the altar was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month, Tianbao year 10, the Yellow Thearch altar was moved to the kun sector inside the inner city. The emperor meant to sacrifice in person; when the altar stood finished, the rite went no further.

sentences.zh: 玄宗先天二年，封華岳神為金天王。

translations.literal: In Xuanzong's second year of Xiantian, enfeoffed Mount Hua's spirit as Golden Heaven King.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanzong's second year of Xiantian, Mount Hua's spirit was enfeoffed as Golden Heaven King.

sentences.zh: 開元十三年，封泰山神為天齊王。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan thirteenth year: enfeoffed Mount Tai's spirit as Heavenly Equilibrium King.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan year 13, Mount Tai's spirit became Heavenly Equilibrium King.

sentences.zh: 天寶五載，封中嶽神為中天王，南嶽神為司天王，北嶽神為安天王。

translations.literal: Tianbao fifth year: enfeoffed the Central Peak spirit as Central Heaven King, the Southern Peak spirit as Director Heaven King, the Northern Peak spirit as Pacifying Heaven King.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao year 5 the Central Peak became Central Heaven King, the Southern Peak Director Heaven King, the Northern Peak Pacifying Heaven King.

sentences.zh: 六載，河瀆封靈源公，濟瀆封清源公，江瀆封廣源公，淮瀆封長源公。

translations.literal: Sixth year: the River Spirit was enfeoffed Spirit Source Prince, the Ji Spirit Clear Source Prince, the Yangtze Spirit Broad Source Prince, the Huai Spirit Long Source Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the River Spirit was named Spirit Source Prince, the Ji Clear Source Prince, the Yangtze Broad Source Prince, the Huai Long Source Prince.

sentences.zh: 十載正月，四海並封為王。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month: the four seas were jointly enfeoffed as kings.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 10 all four seas were enfeoffed as kings.

sentences.zh: 遣國子祭酒嗣吳王祗祭東嶽天齊王，太子家令嗣魯王宇祭南嶽司天王，秘書監崔秀祭中嶽中天王，國子祭酒班景倩祭西嶽金天王，宗正少卿李成裕祭北嶽安天王；

translations.literal: Sent the Imperial University Chancellor, Heir to Prince of Wu Zhi, to sacrifice to Eastern Peak Heavenly Equilibrium King; the Heir Apparent's Household Steward, Heir to Prince of Lu Yu, to Southern Peak Director Heaven King; Secretary Director Cui Xiu to Central Peak Central Heaven King; Imperial University Chancellor Ban Jingqian to Western Peak Golden Heaven King; Court of the Imperial Clan Vice Director Li Chengyu to Northern Peak Pacifying Heaven King;
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial University chancellor and Heir to the Prince of Wu, Zhi, sacrificed to the Eastern Peak, Heavenly Equilibrium King; the heir apparent's household steward and Heir to the Prince of Lu, Yu, to the Southern Peak, Director Heaven King; Secretary Director Cui Xiu to the Central Peak, Central Heaven King; Imperial University Chancellor Ban Jingqian to the Western Peak, Golden Heaven King; Court of the Imperial Clan vice director Li Chengyu to the Northern Peak, Pacifying Heaven King;

sentences.zh: 衛尉少卿李浣祭江瀆廣源公，京兆少尹章恆祭河瀆靈源公，太子左諭德柳偡祭淮瀆長源公，河南少尹豆盧回祭濟瀆清源公；

translations.literal: Weiwei Vice Director Li Huan to Yangtze Spirit Broad Source Prince; Jingzhao Vice Prefect Zhang Heng to River Spirit Spirit Source Prince; Heir Apparent Left Remonstrance Instructor Liu Wei to Huai Spirit Long Source Prince; Henan Vice Prefect Dou Lu Hui to Ji Spirit Clear Source Prince;
translations.idiomatic: Weiwei vice director Li Huan to the Yangtze, Broad Source Prince; Jingzhao vice prefect Zhang Heng to the River, Spirit Source Prince; heir apparent left remonstrance instructor Liu Wei to the Huai, Long Source Prince; Henan vice prefect Dou Lu Hui to the Ji, Clear Source Prince;

sentences.zh: 太子率更令嗣道王煉祭沂山東安公，吳郡太守趙居貞祭會稽山永興公，大理少卿李稹祭吳岳山成德公，潁王府長史甘守默祭霍山應聖公，范陽司馬畢炕祭醫無閭山廣寧公；

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Chief of Palace Services, Heir to Prince of Dao Lian, to Mount Yi Eastern Peace Prince; Wu Prefect Zhao Juzhen to Mount Kuaiji Eternal Prosperity Prince; Court of Review Vice Director Li Zhen to Mount Wu Virtue Realized Prince; Ying Prince Mansion Chief Administrator Gan Shoumo to Mount Huo Response Sage Prince; Fanyang Adjutant Bi Kang to Mount Yiwulu Broad Peace Prince;
translations.idiomatic: Heir apparent chief of palace services and Heir to the Prince of Dao, Lian, to Mount Yi, Eastern Peace Prince; Wu prefect Zhao Juzhen to Mount Kuaiji, Eternal Prosperity Prince; Court of Review vice director Li Zhen to Mount Wu, Virtue Realized Prince; Ying Prince mansion chief administrator Gan Shoumo to Mount Huo, Response Sage Prince; Fanyang adjutant Bi Kang to Mount Yiwulu, Broad Peace Prince;

sentences.zh: 太子中允李隨祭東海廣德王，義王府長史張九章祭南海廣利王，太子中允柳奕祭西海廣潤王，太子洗馬李齊榮祭北海廣澤王。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Middle Attendant Li Sui to Eastern Sea Broad Virtue King; Righteousness Prince Mansion Chief Administrator Zhang Jiuzhang to Southern Sea Broad Benefit King; Heir Apparent Middle Attendant Liu Yi to Western Sea Broad Moisture King; Heir Apparent Palace Groom Li Qirong to Northern Sea Broad Marsh King.
translations.idiomatic: Heir apparent middle attendant Li Sui to the Eastern Sea, Broad Virtue King; Righteousness Prince mansion chief administrator Zhang Jiuzhang to the Southern Sea, Broad Benefit King; heir apparent middle attendant Liu Yi to the Western Sea, Broad Moisture King; heir apparent palace groom Li Qirong to the Northern Sea, Broad Marsh King.

sentences.zh: 取三月十七日一時禮冊。

translations.literal: The investiture rite was set for the seventeenth day of the third month at one double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Investiture was performed on the seventeenth of the third month at the appointed hour.

sentences.zh: 玄宗禦極多年，尚長生輕舉之術。

translations.literal: Xuanzong, having held the throne many years, still favored arts of longevity and ethereal ascent.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong had reigned many years and still courted the arts of longevity and ethereal ascent.

sentences.zh: 於大同殿立真仙之像，每中夜夙興，焚香頂禮。

translations.literal: In the Grand Unity Hall he set images of perfected immortals; each midnight he rose early, burned incense, and bowed forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the Grand Unity Hall he set images of perfected immortals; each midnight he rose before dawn, burned incense, and bowed his forehead to the floor.

sentences.zh: 天下名山，令道士、中官合煉醮祭，相繼于路，投龍奠玉，造精舍，采藥餌，真訣仙蹤，滋於歲月。

translations.literal: Famous mountains throughout the realm were ordered to have Daoist priests and palace eunuchs jointly perform refining rites and sacrifices, succeeding one another along the roads—casting dragon tablets, offering jade, building hermitages, gathering medicinal foods; true formulas and immortal traces multiplied with the years.
translations.idiomatic: At famous mountains across the realm, Daoist priests and palace eunuchs were ordered to perform refining rites and sacrifices in relays along the roads—casting dragon tablets, offering jade, building hermitages, gathering elixir herbs. True formulas and traces of immortals thickened year by year.

sentences.zh: 肅宗至德二載春，在鳳翔，改汧陽郡吳山為西嶽，增秩以祈靈助。

translations.literal: Suzong, spring of Zhide second year, at Fengxiang: changed Qianyang prefecture's Mount Wu to Western Peak, raising its rank to seek spiritual aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Suzong's second year of Zhide, at Fengxiang, Qianyang prefecture's Mount Wu was renamed the Western Peak and its rank raised to beg spiritual aid.

sentences.zh: 及上元二年，聖躬不康，術士請改吳山為華山，華山為泰山，華州為泰州，華陽縣為太陰縣。

translations.literal: By Shangyuan second year the sacred person was unwell; occultists requested changing Mount Wu to Mount Hua, Mount Hua to Mount Tai, Hua prefecture to Tai prefecture, Huayang county to Taiyin county.
translations.idiomatic: By Shangyuan year 2 the emperor's health had failed; occultists urged that Mount Wu be renamed Mount Hua, Mount Hua Mount Tai, Hua prefecture Tai prefecture, and Huayang county Taiyin county.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年，復舊。

translations.literal: Baoying first year: restored the former.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoying year 1 the old names were restored.

sentences.zh: 則天長安三年，令天下諸州宜教人武藝，每年准明經進士例申奏。

translations.literal: Wu Zetian, Chang'an third year: ordered all prefectures under heaven suitably to teach martial arts; each year, on the model of Mingjing presented scholars, to memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: In Wu Zetian's third year of Chang'an, every prefecture was ordered to teach the martial arts; each year candidates were to be memorialized on the model of Mingjing presented scholars.

sentences.zh: 開元十九年，於兩京置太公尚父廟一所，以漢留侯張良配饗。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan nineteenth year: at the two capitals established one Grand Duke Lord Father temple each, with Han's Marquis of Liu Zhang Liang as associate spirit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan year 19 one Grand Duke Lord Father temple was established in each capital, with Han's Marquis of Liu, Zhang Liang, as associate spirit.

sentences.zh: 天寶六載，詔諸州武舉人上省，先謁太公廟，拜將帥亦告太公廟。

translations.literal: Tianbao sixth year: edict that military examination candidates coming to the capital first worship at the Grand Duke temple; appointing generals also reported to the Grand Duke temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao year 6 an edict required military examination candidates bound for the capital to worship first at the Grand Duke temple; appointing generals likewise reported there.

sentences.zh: 至肅宗上元元年閏四月，又尊為武成王，選歷代良將為十哲。

translations.literal: By Suzong's intercalary fourth month of Shangyuan first year, further honored as Martial Accomplishment King; selected eminent generals through the ages as the Ten Sages.
translations.idiomatic: By the intercalary fourth month of Suzong's first year of Shangyuan he was further honored as Martial Accomplishment King, with eminent generals of successive ages chosen as the Ten Sages.

sentences.zh: 高宗顯慶元年三月辛巳，皇后武氏有事於先蠶。

translations.literal: Gaozong, Xianqing first year, third month xinsi: Empress Wu performed rites at the Progenitress of Silk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the third month of Gaozong's first year of Xianqing, Empress Wu performed rites at the Progenitress of Silk.

sentences.zh: 玄宗先天二年三月辛卯，皇后王氏祀先蠶。

translations.literal: Xuanzong, Xiantian second year, third month xinmao: Empress Wang sacrificed to the Progenitress of Silk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the third month of Xuanzong's second year of Xiantian, Empress Wang sacrificed to the Progenitress of Silk.

sentences.zh: 肅宗乾元二年三月己巳，皇后張氏祠先蠶于苑內，內外命婦同采焉。

translations.literal: Suzong, Qianyuan second year, third month jisi: Empress Zhang sacrificed to the Progenitress of Silk within the park; inner and outer titled ladies gathered silk together.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the third month of Suzong's second year of Qianyuan, Empress Zhang sacrificed to the Progenitress within the park, and titled ladies within and without the palace gathered silk together.

sentences.zh: 舊儀，大祭祀，宮懸、軒縣奏於庭，登歌於堂上。

translations.literal: Old regulations: at great sacrifices, palace suspended and district suspended music played in the court; ascent songs on the hall.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation, at great sacrifices palace music and district music sounded in the courtyard while ascent songs rose in the hall.

sentences.zh: 自至德二載克復兩京後，樂工不備，時又艱食，諸壇廟祭享，空有登歌，無壇下、庭中樂及三舞。

translations.literal: From after recovering the two capitals in Zhide second year, musicians were incomplete and food was scarce; at shrine and temple offerings there remained only ascent songs, without music below the altar or in the courtyard, nor the three dances.
translations.idiomatic: After the two capitals were recovered in Zhide year 2, musicians were few and food scarce; at shrine and temple offerings only ascent songs remained—no music below the altar or in the courtyard, and no three dances.

sentences.zh: 舊儀，凡祭享，有司行事，則太尉奠瓚幣，司徒拜俎，司空掃除，太尉初獻，太常卿亞獻，光祿卿終獻。

translations.literal: Old regulations: whenever sacrifice was performed by officials, the Grand Marshal laid the libation vessel and silks, the Minister of Education bowed over the offering tray, the Minister of Works swept; the Grand Marshal made the first offering, the Director of Rites the second, the Director of Imperial Commissary the final.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation, when officials performed the sacrifice, the grand marshal set out the libation vessel and silks, the minister of education bowed over the offering tray, the minister of works swept clean; the grand marshal made the first offering, the director of rites the second, the director of the imperial commissariat the last.

sentences.zh: 自上元後，南郊、九宮神壇、太廟，備此五官，余即太常卿攝司空，光祿卿攝司徒，貴省於事。

translations.literal: After Shangyuan, for the Southern Suburbs, Nine Palaces spirit altar, and Imperial Ancestral Temple, all five offices were complete; for the rest the Director of Rites stood in as Minister of Works and the Director of Imperial Commissary as Minister of Education—valuing economy in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Shangyuan the five offices were fully staffed for the Southern Suburbs, the Nine Palaces altar, and the Imperial Ancestral Temple; for other rites the director of rites stood in as minister of works and the director of the imperial commissariat as minister of education—to spare labor.

sentences.zh: 舊儀，有協律郎立於阼階上，麾竿以節樂，今無協律之位。

translations.literal: Old regulations: the pitch regulator stood on the east steps, baton in hand to time the music; now there is no pitch-regulator position.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation a pitch regulator stood on the east steps, baton in hand to beat time for the music; that post no longer exists.

sentences.zh: 舊儀，光祿欲為祭饌，將陽燧望日取火，謂之明火。

translations.literal: Old regulations: when the Imperial Commissary was about to prepare sacrificial food, the yang fire-striker was aimed at the sun to draw fire—called bright fire.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation, when the imperial commissariat prepared sacrificial food, a yang fire-striker was aimed at the sun to draw flame—this was called bright fire.

sentences.zh: 太牢皆棧飼於廩犧署，以至充腯。

translations.literal: The great victims were all stall-fed at the granary and sacrificial office until plump.
translations.idiomatic: The great victims were stall-fed at the granary and sacrificial herds office until they grew plump.

sentences.zh: 臨祭視其充瘦，謂之省牲，肅宗上元二年九月，改元為元年，詔：「圓丘方澤，依恆存一太牢。

translations.literal: Before sacrifice their fullness or leanness was inspected—called examining the victims. Suzong, ninth month of Shangyuan second year, changed the era name to Yuan first year, edict: "For the round mound and square moat, per custom retain one great victim.
translations.idiomatic: Before sacrifice their fullness or leanness was inspected—this was called examining the victims. In the ninth month of Suzong's second year of Shangyuan the era name was changed to Yuan year 1, with an edict: "For the round mound and square moat, per custom one great victim shall remain.

sentences.zh: 皇廟諸祠，臨時獻熟。

translations.literal: Imperial temple and various shrines: offer cooked meat when the occasion requires."
translations.idiomatic: For the imperial temple and other shrines, offer cooked meat as each occasion requires."

sentences.zh: 」今昊天上帝、太廟，一牢，羊豕各三，餘祭盡隨事辦供以備禮。

translations.literal: Now for Supreme Heaven and the Imperial Ancestral Temple, one pen; three sheep and three swine each; other sacrifices all provision according to the affair to complete ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Now for Supreme Heaven and the Imperial Ancestral Temple there is one pen, with three sheep and three swine; all other sacrifices are provisioned as each affair requires, merely to fulfill ritual.

sentences.zh: 明火、棧飼之禮，亦不暇矣。

translations.literal: The rites of bright fire and stall-feeding—there is no leisure for them anymore.
translations.idiomatic: As for the rites of bright fire and stall-feeding, there is no longer time for them.
